title: Talent Lead- Bengaluru, IND
description:
Job Summary Talent Acquisition Lead India | Global Talent Acquisition Shift Timing - IST 5 PM - 2 AM Overview of Position The Talent Acquisition Lead is responsible for implementing talent acquisition processes across Diversified s global operations, including the US, Canada, EMEA, Australia and India. Based in Bangalore, this position will lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists supporting sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer coordination, helping deliver consistent service and an outstanding experience for internal and external candidates. The Talent Acquisition Lead partners with global (US-based) Talent Acquisition leadership, regional HR teams, and hiring leaders to translate agreed processes into practical workflows, support adoption, and contribute ideas for improvement. Success requires demonstrated experience implementing comparable recruitment processes across regions, excellent spoken and written English, and the ability to use ATS and candidate data to improve hiring efficiency and service quality. Key Accountabilities Implement talent acquisition processes globally, adapting execution to regional requirements in partnership with local HR while maintaining consistent standards. Develop and execute rollout plans covering process documentation, responsibilities, training, milestones, and adoption tracking; identify barriers and coordinate practical solutions with the appropriate leaders. Establish clear workflows and service expectations from requisition intake through sourcing, interview scheduling, offer coordination, and handoff to onboarding. Lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists through training, regular feedback, quality reviews, and hands-on support for complex or urgent needs. Help coordinate team priorities, monitor capacity and service delivery, and work with the appropriate leaders to address bottlenecks across regions and time zones. Ensure sourcing aligns with role requirements and agreed recruiting strategies, interview scheduling is responsive, and offer documentation and approvals are accurate and timely. Work collaboratively with senior leaders and hiring teams to understand hiring needs, share progress, and contribute practical ideas that support effective recruitment. Partner with recruiters, HRBPs, hiring managers, and external recruitment partners to clarify responsibilities, address questions, and support consistent follow-through. Provide a professional, respectful candidate experience through timely updates, clear interview instructions, reliable coordination, and appropriate communication when candidates are not selected. Gather candidate and hiring manager feedback and implement improvements to communication, scheduling, and offer processes that reflect Diversified s values and employer brand. Partner with HR Operations and technology teams to align ATS workflows, templates, approvals, and reporting with the global process; support consistent system use and accurate records. Analyze ATS utilization, open requisition aging, time to fill, time to hire, time in stage, sourcing effectiveness, candidate conversion, withdrawals, and offer acceptance. Prepare recurring dashboards and concise reporting that explain trends, identify bottlenecks, recommend actions, and track the impact of process improvements. Establish consistent metric definitions and data quality checks with HR Operations; protect candidate confidentiality and follow company policies and applicable regional requirements in partnership with local HR. Qualifications Education Education: Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered. Experience 8+ years of progressive talent acquisition or recruitment operations experience, including at least 3 years leading, guiding, and coaching a recruitment or talent acquisition support team. Global Implementation Experience: Demonstrated success implementing standardized recruitment processes across multiple countries or regions, including supporting US stakeholders from India or another global delivery location. Must provide concrete examples of personal ownership from planning through adoption and measurable outcomes. Team Leadership: Proven experience leading, guiding, and coaching specialists responsible for sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer preparation or coordination. English Communication: Excellent spoken and written English is essential, including the ability to participate effectively in discussions with senior leaders, share ideas clearly, write polished candidate communications, and explain data and process changes. Systems and Analytics: Strong working knowledge of enterprise ATS platforms, recruitment workflows, reporting, and data quality practices. Strong Excel skills and the ability to translate recruitment data into practical recommendations. Dayforce ATS and Power BI experience preferred. Skills and Competencies Strong relationship-building, coaching, process implementation, problem-solving, and organizational skills; sound judgment and the ability to balance competing priorities and support change. Global Collaboration: Ability to work across cultures and time zones, with planned overlap with US and other regional business hours. Industry Experience: Experience supporting technology, engineering, or project delivery recruitment preferred. Key Success Metrics Delivers agreed global rollout milestones and achieves consistent process adoption across participating regions. Strengthens specialist capability and improves responsiveness, accuracy, and completion of sourcing, scheduling, and offer coordination activities. Improves ATS utilization, data completeness, and timely updates to requisition and candidate records. Reduces avoidable delays, aged open requisitions, and time spent in hiring stages against agreed baselines and targets. Improves candidate and hiring manager feedback, candidate progression, and offer acceptance through better communication and coordination. Provides accurate, timely reporting and recommendations that result in measurable recruitment process improvements.

description:
Alation is pioneering the next era of data intelligence - powered by AI agents and trusted data . Organizations around the world rely on Alation to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding - valued at over $1.7 billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune 100. As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed. Joining Alation means being part of a winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence . We move fast, think big, and deliver results together. About the Role 
 Were looking for a hands-on NOC Engineer who can also handle security monitoring and incidents. Youll monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across our AWS and Kubernetes environments, respond to security alerts, and automate repetitive work - thinking clearly under pressure and owning incidents end to end 
 Network / Cloud Operations (NOC) 
 Monitor the health, availability and performance of AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, applications and networks, 24x7 on a rotational basis. Act as L2 escalation point: triage, troubleshoot, debug and resolve incidents escalated from L1 or raised by monitoring tools. Analyze logs, metrics and traces to find root causes across compute, network, storage, database and application layers. Troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads (pods, deployments, services, ingress, nodes) using kubectl and related tools. Escalate to engineering, cloud and vendor teams with clear, complete technical context when needed. Tune alerts and dashboards to reduce noise and improve signal quality. Support change, maintenance and release windows, including validation and rollback checks. 
 Security Operations (SOC) 
 Monitor security alerts from SIEM, cloud security tools (e.g., AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail) and endpoint/network sources. Triage, investigate and classify security events; separate false positives from real threats. Execute first response on security incidents: containment, evidence collection, escalation and follow-up. Identify suspicious activity such as unauthorized access, IAM misuse, unusual network traffic, malware or data exfiltration indicators. Follow and improve security incident response playbooks. Support vulnerability management, access reviews and audit evidence requests. 
 Automation and Continuous Improvement 
 Automate repetitive operational and security tasks using scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go, etc.) or low-code / no-code tools (e.g., n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, SOAR platforms, Lambda, AWS Systems Manager). Build auto-remediation, alert enrichment and ticket auto-creation workflows. Write and maintain runbooks, SOPs and knowledge base articles. title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
Job Summary Grant Thornton GTech s Data Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption. Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns. Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation). Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption. Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders. Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs. Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers. Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets. Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation. Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

company: Law Offices of Mazher M. Shah-Khan, P.C. of USA
description:
Job Title: Docketing & Litigation Manager (US Immigration Court Specialist) 
 Department: Litigation & Operations
 Location: Remote (India Hub)
 Shift Matrix: Evening/Night Shift (US Central Time Zone alignment)
 Reports To: Managing Partner / Lead Litigation Attorney 
 Position Overview: We are a high-growth US Immigration Law firm seeking a highly analytical and process-driven Docketing & Litigation Manager to lead our court-calendar compliance and case-tracking operations. In this role, you will be the absolute baseline of defense against missed deadlines. You will oversee the end-to-end docketing lifestyle for all removal defense, asylum, Board of Immigration Appeals (BIA), and federal court filings. 
 The ideal candidate has exhaustive hands-on experience navigating the EOIR Courts and Appeals System (ECAS) , calculating non-standard statutory timelines, and managing a team of specialists or coordinating directly with US-based trial attorneys. 
 Core Responsibilities & Job Duties1. EOIR & BIA Docket Management (Crucial Compliance) Calculate & Log Deadlines: Review, interpret, and accurately calculate complex legal deadlines from EOIR notices, BIA scheduling orders, and DHS filings. This includes calculating timeframes for Form EOIR-27, Notices of Appeal (Form EOIR-26), evidentiary submissions, individual hearings, and motion responses. ECAS Oversight: Monitor the automated EOIR Courts and Appeals System (ECAS) daily. Process electronic submission receipts, troubleshoot filing confirmation discrepancies, and audit digital court queues. BIA Mailbox Rule Compliance: Enforce absolute adherence to BIA receipt-date rules, ensuring all appellate filings are tracked to arrive physically or electronically before strict deadlines, neutralizing filing risks. 2. System Administration & Auditing IPMS / Practice Management Owner: Oversee the data integrity of our Immigration Practice Management System (e.g., INSZoom). Ensure every active litigation file has accurate, fully populated task dependencies. Quality Assurance Auditing: Run daily, weekly, and monthly docketing audit reports. Cross-reference automated system rules with official court dockets to catch discrepancies, resolving errors before they impact active cases. Disaster Recovery & Redundancy: Manage the firm's backup manual tracking mechanisms (e.g., shared Master Calendar protocols) to guarantee zero downtime or visibility losses. 3. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination Workflow Distribution: Supervise and assign tasks to paralegals (if applicable), serving as the primary escalation point for rule interpretation queries. Attorney Liaison Support: Actively coordinate with US-based trial attorneys. Provide daily "high-priority alert" briefs detailing upcoming Individual Hearings, Master Calendar hearings, and strict pleading deadlines. Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Development: Design, document, and update internal firm SOPs regarding data entry standards, notice triage workflows, and digital archiving guidelines to scale alongside the growing practice. Required Qualifications & Technical Skills Education: Bachelors degree in Law (LL.B.), Legal Studies, Business Administration, or equivalent corporate data/operations experience. Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in US legal data operations, with at least 2+ years explicitly focused on US Immigration Court (EOIR/BIA) docketing and litigation administration . Software Competency: Direct proficiency with ECAS (EOIR portal) and standard US case management tools (e.g., Docketwise, INSZoom, Filevine, Clio). Critical Thinking: Exceptional ability to interpret legal jargon and parse complex court orders to isolate exact filing requirements. Communication & Shift Work: Flawless written English communication skills. Absolute willingness and ability to work a fixed night shift or late afternoon mid-shift to ensure real-time coordination with US office hours.

Key Skills: Docketing,Law,Litigation management,Litigation,Management

Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Ability to understand design specifications, can contribute to design planning, partitioning, and setup a feasible seed for convergence PD cycle. Extensive experience in STA closure on complex design with ability to understand the clocks structure from both functional and DFT side and provide solutions to complete design closure. Worked on synthesis of high frequency designs and come up PPA solutions to meet the targets. Good understanding of EDA tools such as Fusion Compiler, Innovus, Primetime, Tempus, VCLP, LEC. Strong understanding of static timing analysis, power analysis, and signal integrity analysis. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent scripting skills and development of utilities to reduce overall TAT. Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with cross-functional teams. Experience in mentoring and coaching junior engineers is a plus.

Client Interaction Relationship Management: Under supervision, you will gain exposure to client interactions, learning professional communication standards and relationship management practices. title: Purchase, Category & Sourcing Executive
description:
1. Product Selection & Category Building 
 Recommend which products and brands CIY should keep, add or remove based on sales data, customer demand, store feedback and seasonal trends. Find new products in craft, art, hobby, stationery, gifting, sewing, beads, yarn and related categories. Help build better product ranges for store shelves and online. 
 
 2. Own-Brand Product Development (strategic priority) 
 Help CIY source products to be sold under the CIY own brand this is a key growth lever for the business. Drive sample follow-up, costing, packaging coordination and supplier comparison. Identify products with strong demand and healthy margin potential. Work under founder guidance for final product decisions, but bring strong sourcing options to the table. 
 
 3. Buying & Reordering 
 Check sales and stock every week. Prepare reorder plans for fast-selling products. Keep top-selling products in stock above 95% of the time. Avoid overbuying products that may not sell. Follow up with suppliers until products are received and ready to sell. 
 
 4. Supplier & Factory Sourcing 
 Find new suppliers, wholesalers and direct factories. Compare prices, quality, delivery time and payment terms. Negotiate better buying prices and terms. Build backup supplier options for important products. Visit local markets and suppliers regularly. Expect 12 days per week of field work in Pune; occasional travel to Mumbai or Delhi for trade shows. 
 
 5. Pricing & Profit 
 Check buying price, transport cost, packaging cost and selling price before purchase. Help set prices that are competitive but still profitable. Suggest bundles, offers and discount ideas to clear slow stock. Avoid buying decisions that block cash or reduce profit. 
 
 6. Slow Stock Control 
 Track products that are not selling. Suggest action: bundle, discount, better display, online push, return to supplier or stop reordering. Work with the store team to improve visibility of slow products. Reduce old stock month by month. 
 
 7. Store & Online Coordination 
 Walk the store regularly and speak to the store team. Understand what customers are asking for what is selling, what is stuck, what is missing. Coordinate with the online team for correct product names, prices, photos and details. Make sure ordered stock, received stock and supplier bills match before closing purchases. 
 
 Daily & Weekly Work 
 Check sales and current stock daily. Make reorder lists and place purchase orders after approval. Follow up with suppliers for delivery and resolve issues. Compare supplier rates regularly; benchmark existing vendors against new quotes. Visit markets and suppliers 12 days per week. Walk the store at least twice a week to spot stockouts and slow movers. Share a weekly report: what sold well, what is out of stock, what was ordered, what is stuck and what action is needed next. 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Top-selling products stay in stock above 95% of the time. Slow and old stock reduces every month. Buying prices improve over time; supplier payment terms get more favourable. Supplier delivery becomes faster and more reliable. Store team gets the right products at the right time. CIY own-brand products move from idea to sample to store shelf. Purchase decisions become planned, not last-minute. 
 
 Who Should Apply 
 You should apply if you are: Practical, fast and reliable. Good with numbers and simple spreadsheets. Strong in follow-up you finish what you start. Comfortable talking to and negotiating with suppliers in Hindi, Marathi or basic English. Willing to do field work and market visits this is not a desk-only role. Able to think like a business owner, not just an employee. Interested in products, retail, craft, design, stationery, fashion accessories, gifting or home products. 
 
 Experience Required 
 Minimum 1 year and up to 4 years of experience in purchase, retail buying, merchandising, sourcing, supplier management, retail operations or wholesale market work. Hands-on experience running a family business, working in a wholesale market, or actively trading and reselling products counts as relevant experience tell us about it in your answers. Pure academic backgrounds without practical street experience will not be considered for this role. 
 
 Skills Needed 
 Google Sheets or Excel. Basic maths: price, quantity, margin, discount and transport cost. Supplier negotiation. Product comparison and market research. Follow-up and execution. Clear communication in Hindi and basic English. Marathi is a strong plus. 
 
 Good to Have 
 Experience in art, craft, stationery, fabric, yarn, beads, gifting, fashion accessories or home products. Knowledge of Pune local wholesale markets (Budhwar Peth, Laxmi Road) or Mumbai (Crawford Market, Bhuleshwar). Experience with Shopify, Zoho or any inventory software. Personal interest in DIY, craft, knitting, crochet, sewing, painting, jewellery making or creative products. 
 
 Performance Will Be Measured On 
 Availability of top-selling products: 95% in-stock target. Reduction in old and slow stock month over month. Improvement in buying rates and supplier payment terms. On-time supplier delivery rate. Accuracy and speed of reorder planning. Own-brand product progress samples to shelves. Clean and current purchase and supplier data.

title: Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Unit Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early. In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend. We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds. Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules. 

 Responsibilities 
 As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately. Synthetic Testing: Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan. So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today" and see what the AI says. Does the AI say yesDoes it calculate the early payment fee correctlyWhat if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spellingWhat if you type in a mix of Hindi and EnglishWhat if you pretend to be very angryDoes the AI still understand and stay politeYou will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly. LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain): The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to. If a customer types, "What is my balance", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters. As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI." You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks. Visualisations: Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen. Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations. Let\'s say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly. Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn\'t make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use. Product Switching: Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand." At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing. We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later. Conversation Flows: A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows. You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen. 
Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help" -> Arrow points to Box 2. 
Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3. 
Box 3: The system checks if the customer\'s phone number is verified. 
If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4. 
If No -> Arrow points to Box 5. 
Box 4: Show the statement on the screen. 
Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP). You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone What if the internet crashes You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write

title: Director International Operations (Logistics)
description:
Job Overview We are seeking a seasoned, high-caliber logistics leader for the role of Director – Cross-Border Operations. Based out of our Gurgaon headquarters, you will lead end-to-end international logistics operations for Delhivery, overseeing cross-border import and export shipments across key global trade lanes. This is a strategic and execution-intensive role. You will spearhead the expansion of our international freight network by launching new country corridors and deferred air economy products, while driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships. This position owns P&L, SLA compliance, and operational efficiency for both air and ocean freight verticals. Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End International Logistics Operations Lead end-to-end international logistics operations, managing and optimizing cross-border import and export shipments across global trade lanes. Supervise daily workflows for inbound and outbound cargo, ensuring smooth execution across origin handling, international linehaul, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery. Implement robust monitoring systems to track shipments, proactively resolve operational exceptions, and ensure high on-time delivery rates. Should be able to create and manage dashboards  Hold reviews internally with cross functional teams and externally with partners in destination country Should be able to design using BI tools and define metrics internally and for partners 2. Network Expansion & Product Development Spearhead the physical and operational expansion of Delhivery's international freight network by identifying and launching new country corridors. Design, launch, and scale deferred air economy products to offer competitive, cost-effective cross-border shipping options to e-commerce, SME, and enterprise clients. Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational readiness criteria for all newly launched corridors and lanes. 3. Strategic Partnerships & Carrier Management Identify, negotiate with, and onboard key global partners, including freight forwarders, customs house agents (CHAs), customs brokers, and commercial airlines/ocean carriers. Build and maintain strong strategic alliances to secure capacity commitments, preferential rate structures, and reliable transit times during peak and non-peak seasons. Manage partner performance SLAs, conducting regular reviews to ensure compliance with Delhivery's high operational standards. 4. P&L & SLA Compliance Management Take complete financial ownership of the Air and Ocean freight verticals, managing P&L, cost optimization, and overall unit economics (e.g., cost-per-kilogram and route margins). Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Transit Turnaround Time (TAT), On-Time Delivery (OTD), Customs Clearance timelines, and first-contact dispute resolution. Control and minimize operational exceptions such as terminal storage costs, demurrage, detention fees, and flight offloads. 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Tech Enablement Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Sales, Business Development, Technology, and Legal/Compliance to support business growth and process standardization. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to build scalable, automated, and technology-driven processes for tracking, billing, and customs documentation. Ensure 100% adherence to international trade laws, customs regulations, aviation security standards, and safety compliances. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience & Education Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or Post-Graduate degree is highly preferred. Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in international logistics, freight forwarding, or cross-border e-commerce shipping. Leadership: Minimum of 3+ years in a senior supervisory or managerial role directly overseeing air/ocean freight operations, partner management, or international linehaul. Core Competencies Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of air/ocean freight operations, global trade lanes, Incoterms 2020, customs clearance regulations, and HAWB/MAWB rules (aligned with our Global Air Freight Operations). Commercial & Financial Acumen: Strong experience managing P&L, negotiating complex commercial contracts, and optimizing unit economics. Analytical Rigor: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets for tracking operations, data analysis, and building performance dashboards. Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Exceptional negotiation and relationship-building skills to manage high-level partnerships across multiple geographies. Problem-Solving: Strong critical-thinking and crisis-management abilities to handle transit disruptions, customs bottlenecks, and capacity constraints in a high-pressure environmen

title: AM-Taxation
description:
Job purpose: To support and independently manage day-to-day Direct Taxation and TDS compliances, including timely filing of TDS returns, reconciliation of books with statutory returns, preparation and response to Income Tax notices, tax data analysis, and coordination with internal teams and consultants. The role will also require a working understanding of GST and other indirect tax matters to support the overall Taxation function. 
 Primary responsibilities: 1. TDS Compliance & Return Filing • Ensure timely preparation and filing of quarterly TDS/TCS returns within statutory due dates. • Review TDS applicability and rates on various payments such as rent, professional fees, contractor payments, commission, interest and other business expenses. • Reconcile TDS deducted in books with TDS returns before filing. • Coordinate for correction/revised TDS returns wherever required. Monitor TDS challans, deductions, balances and statutory payment status. • Support issuance and reconciliation of Form 16/16A and other TDS certificates. 
 2. Books vs. Return Reconciliation Perform regular reconciliation between books of accounts and TDS returns. • Identify differences in TDS deduction, vendor PAN, amount, section, rate and challan details. • Reconcile TDS/TCS balances with Form 26AS/AIS/TIS, wherever applicable. Coordinate with Accounts, Payroll, Procurement and other departments for resolution of reconciliation differences. • Maintain proper reconciliation workings and supporting documents for audit and assessment purposes. 
 3. Income Tax Notices & Assessments • Monitor and maintain records of Income Tax notices, communications and proceedings. • Prepare data, reconciliations and supporting documents required for responding to Income Tax notices. • Coordinate with tax consultants and internal stakeholders for preparation and submission of replies. Assist in matters relating to TDS defaults, demands, assessments and other Income Tax proceedings. Track notice-wise status, due dates, submissions and closure of outstanding matters. Maintain a proper Income Tax Notice & Litigation Tracker. 
 4. Direct Tax Compliance & Taxation Support Assist in preparation of advance tax, self-assessment tax and tax computation workings. Support preparation of tax audit and income-tax-related schedules and information. Assist in computation and reconciliation of current tax and other direct tax-related balances. • Support statutory, internal and tax audits by providing required information and documents. • Keep track of amendments and notifications under the Income-tax Act, Rules and applicable TDS provisions. 
 5. GST / Indirect Tax Knowledge Possess working knowledge of GST provisions, GST returns and basic ITC concepts. Understand the interaction between GST and direct tax/TDS transactions wherever applicable. • Assist the Taxation Team in reconciliation and analysis of GST-related data when required. • Coordinate with the GST team for common tax data, vendor details and reconciliation requirements. Develop working knowledge of GST notices, compliance requirements and relevant provisions. 
 Required Skills: • Good knowledge of TDS/TCS provisions and Income-tax Act. • Practical experience in TDS return preparation and filing. • Strong reconciliation skills Books vs. TDS Returns vs. 26AS/AIS/TIS. • Experience in handling/preparing data for Income Tax notices and assessments. • Working knowledge of GST and indirect taxation. • Good knowledge of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS and reconciliation techniques. • Good analytical and problem-solving skills. • Ability to coordinate with internal departments and external consultants

Key Skills: TDS,Direct Tax,Tax Compliance,Taxation,Indirect Taxation,Tax Audit,Tax Returns,ITR

title: HR Business Partner - Night shift
description:
Job Objective: Sr HR Executive specializing in Time & Attendance and MIS reporting is to ensure accurate and efficient management of employee attendance, provide valuable insights through data analysis, and support the HR department in making informed decisions that contribute to the overall success of the organization. Specializing in Data Management typically involves responsibilities related to managing and optimizing HR data and information within an organization. 
 Key Deliverables: Time and Attendance Management: Efficiently manage and oversee the time and attendance system for the organization. Monitor and ensure accurate recording of employee work hours, leaves, and attendance data. Implement and enforce attendance policies and procedures. Data Management: Collect, validate, and enter HR data into databases, ensuring its accuracy and completeness. Continuously update and maintain employee records, ensuring compliance with data privacy and security regulations. Establish and enforce data quality standards to maintain the integrity of HR data, preventing errors and inconsistencies. Employee Support: Address employee queries and concerns related to attendance, leave balances, and other HR-related matters. Provide guidance on company policies and procedures. MIS Reporting: Develop, maintain, and enhance Management Information System (MIS) for HR data and reporting. Generate regular reports and dashboards related to attendance, employee performance, and other HR metrics. Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement. Compliance: Ensure compliance with labor laws and regulations related to attendance and payroll. Assist in preparing and submitting necessary reports to government authorities or auditors. Data Analysis and Decision Support: Utilize data analysis tools and techniques to extract actionable insights, such as trends in workforce demographics, attrition, and employee performance. Assist in making data-driven decisions to improve workforce management. Technology and Software Management: Stay updated on HR technology and software solutions related to time and attendance. Manage the implementation and maintenance of HRIS or attendance tracking software. Team Collaboration: Collaborate with other HR team members and departments to ensure the smooth functioning of HR processes. Reporting to Senior Management: Present findings and reports to senior management, HR leadership, and other relevant stakeholders. Key Performance Indicators: Data Accuracy and Integrity: Percentage of accurate and error- free HR data entries and updates. Measure the consistency and reliability of HR data over time. Timeliness of Data: Measure how quickly HR data is updated after events (e.g., new hires, promotions, payroll, reports, ESIC & UAN generation). Process Efficiency Improvement: The number of process improvements implemented to enhance data management and time & attendance tracking. Data Analysis and Reporting Accuracy: Evaluate the precision of data analysis and reporting provided to HR leaders and other stakeholders. Attendance & Payroll Accuracy Rate: This KPI measures the accuracy of attendance calculations and processing payroll on time. Employee Satisfaction: The time taken to resolve employee inquiries or issues. Data Security and Confidentiality: Ensuring the security of employee personal & payroll data to prevent data breaches and unauthorized access. Key Roles/ Key Responsibility Areas include but are not limited to: Employee life cycle activities Maintaining Employee Database, HRIS and employee related data activities. Maintaining and reviewing accurate, error-free databases. On time & error free processing of letters, completion of post-joining formalities along with proper on time documentation of files. Maintaining the data on HRIS on time with accuracy. Taking care of employees background verification form third party agency. Taking care of medical insurance file processing and updating monthly addition/deletion of employees including their family members in medical policy. Preparing Appointment, Confirmation, Experience & Relieving letter. MIS Reports Preparing reports like Attrition reports, Organization Chart, Monthly HR Dashboard, and any other report when required. Thinking of new ways of representing data and helping business to make data driven decisions. Compensation Management Leaves and Attendance Management in Matrix. Handling monthly payroll for employees on Saral Software. Generating UAN and ESIC numbers for all new joiners. Internal Interfaces: For Example Business Stakeholders, Recruitment Team, Hiring Managers, Management, HOD, Admin Team, Employees, IT Team External Interfaces: For Example Vendors, Candidates, Consultants, Vendors, Colleges, Institutions 
 ESSENTIAL SKILLS: Microsoft Office Suite (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio): For creating and managing various HR documents, including Employee Master, Attrition reports, Organization Charts, Dashboards and Presentations. Software Proficiency: Familiarity with time & attendance and payroll software. Data Analysis Tools: Familiarity with data analysis tools like Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or specialized data analysis software and analyzing HR data. Problem-solving: Addressing attendance or data issues and resolving conflicts. Organizational Skills: Managing schedules, Shift and time off request along with HR data changes request. Reporting: Generating various HR reports for HR and management. 
 DESIRABLE PERSONALITY TRAITS: HR Executive should include integrity, analytical thinking, detail-oriented, communication skills, adaptability and a commitment to data accuracy and confidentiality. Knowledge / Skills / Experience Knowledge: Time & Attendance Management, Matrix & Saral System, Report Generation, Data Analysis Tools, Data Management. title: ADME Scientist
description:
ADME Scientist, ADME/IVB Profiling team (ADME - Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, and Excretion) (IVB - In Vitro Bioanalysis, often referred to as in vitro DMPK (Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics) 
 Job description 
 About the role 
 We are seeking a ADME scientist to growth our compound Profiling team (full time role). Specialised in DMPK of small molecule therapeutics, the ideal candidate will have a proven track record in developing ADME methods, profiling compounds in ADME assays and executing PK studies supporting drug projects at Discovery & PreClinical stage. As a key member of Topia Profiling team, you will drive data quality & efficiency for Program execution. You will leverage your experience & expertise in wet lab activities as well as keeping ELN records up to date. This role is part of Topia own capabilities in delivering drug pipeline of internal and partnered projects while having an impact on expanding Topia Tech Infrastructure. This Ahmedabad-based position reports directly to ADME/IVB Profiling Senior Manager. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Experimental Design & Execution 
 Conduct in vitro ADME assays and in vivo DMPK studies, including aqueous solubility (UV/HPLC/LCMS), permeability, metabolic stability, protein binding, CYP inhibition, and CYP profiling. Develop and validate analytical methods (LC-MS/MS, HPLC) for drug quantification. Perform pharmacokinetic and bioanalytical studies to characterize drug disposition. 
 Data Analysis & Interpretation 
 Perform data processing, statistical analysis, and interpretation of ADME and PK results. Provide scientific recommendations for candidate selection and dose regimen design. 
 Collaboration & Reporting 
 Coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams (e.g., chemistry, biology, clinical). Prepare clear, well-documented reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Act as Topia Scientific Excellences ambassador, promoting our culture of collaboration and inclusion. 
 Qualifications & Skills 
 PhD or Masters in Pharmacology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or related field. 3–5 years for entry-level; 7+ years for senior/principal scientist roles. Strong knowledge of drug metabolism pathways, ADME assay validation, optimization, and enzyme kinetics. Experience in running PK studies (in life and/or analytical phase) is a plus Proficiency with bioanalytical techniques (multimode readers, LC-MS/MS, HPLC). description:
Position Title: Enterprise Architecture - Senior Manager Architecture - GR - 40551-75745-1 - Job Family: IFT > IT Architecture Shift: 2nd Shift (India) Job Title Senior Manager Architecture Requirement Type Full-Time Employee Job Location Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurugram Job Level Senior Manager Hiring Manager Senior Director Technology Primary Skill Enterprise Architecture, Pharmacy Platforms, AI Spec-Driven Development Business iRx IDW Data Mgmt Individual Contributor / People Manager People Manager ABOUT ELEVANCE HEALTH Elevance Health is a leading health company in America dedicated to improving lives and communities and making healthcare simpler. It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability. Implementation: capability readiness, integration completeness, migration quality, cutover readiness, production stability, adoption, and business outcome realization. Engineering: cycle-time improvement, automation coverage, defect escape reduction, reliability, developer experience, and maintainability. AI SDD: specification coverage and traceability, governed AI adoption, reusable agent workflows, quality of generated artifacts, and validated productivity benefits. Organization: critical-skill coverage, leadership bench strength, team health, succession readiness, and growth of architecture and engineering capability. Delivery: predictable release support and governance compliance, intentionally weighted below architecture, implementation, engineering, and business outcomes. THE CARELON PROMISE Aligning with our brand belief of limitless minds are our biggest asset , we offer a world of limitless opportunities to our associates. It is our strong belief that one is committed to a role when it is not just what the role entails, but also what lies in its periphery that completes the value circle for an associate. This world of limitless opportunities thrives in an environment that fosters growth and well-being, and gives you purpose and the feeling of belonging. title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure,Kubernetes
description:
Job Description About the role We are hiring a staff software engineer (IC4) for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse. We are distributed across Israel, India, and the Americas. This is a full stack role with its center of gravity firmly on the infrastructure side - expect roughly two-thirds of your time on telemetry infrastructure, data pipelines, Kubernetes and DevOps work, and the rest on the services and product surfaces on top. You will be equally comfortable designing a distributed system and owning it in production. If you like following a system from the event that fires to the chart that renders - and you want the pager for it - you will feel at home. You will lead design and delivery of complex, multi-service features, own technical decisions within a domain, and are fully self-directed - escalating only genuine ambiguities and driving decisions to closure. Of the ten critical skills at this level, incident response management is the only one set at Expert; the rest are Experienced. What you ll do Telemetry infrastructure and data pipelines Design, build, and own backend services for distributed data streaming and processing that handle high-volume, high-cardinality event data with predictable latency and no silent data loss. Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming pipelines and the pipeline components that feed ClickHouse. Own data modeling and query performance in ClickHouse - partitioning, sort keys, materialized views, retention, and the cost curve that comes with all of it. Partner with product and platform teams to shape requirements for telemetry ingestion and processing, then drive the solutions to production. Kubernetes, DevOps, and production ownership Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. Own observability for what you build - meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise. Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives. Full stack engineering and technical leadership Own the full development lifecycle for your work, and build the backend services and APIs that expose telemetry to internal consumers, product surfaces, and AI agents - including API contracts, data models, and schema migrations. Contribute to the analytics front end - dashboards, funnels, and exploration tools - with an eye on performance against large result sets, and improve the web and mobile capture SDKs. Lead the design of complex, multi-service features across team boundaries, drive decisions to closure, and write the design docs and postmortems that outlive the conversation. Raise the bar through code review, test strategy, and automation coverage, and mentor engineers on the team. Qualifications Experience and education requirements The job profile defines IC4 by scope, independence, and impact rather than years served. The minimums below are the screening bar for this requisition. Requirement Mandatory minimum 8+ years of Backend software engineering experience 4+ years of Designing and operating distributed systems 3+ years Kubernetes in production, including Helm and CI/CD 3+ years Kafka or equivalent streaming and data pipelines 3+ years On-call and production ownership Bachelor s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field Required A master s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable. Required qualifications Strong backend development experience in Java, Python, Go or equivalent, used in production at scale. Hands-on experience building distributed systems for data streaming, processing, and storage. Production experience deploying and managing services on Kubernetes, including Helm and CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of Kafka or an equivalent messaging and streaming system. Solid SQL skills and hands-on experience with a columnar or analytical data store, including query optimization and physical data modeling. Demonstrated depth in incident responseand customer escalations Enough front-end capability to build and debug a data-heavy interface: JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Angular. Desired qualifications Production experience with ClickHouse or another OLAP or columnar store - sharding, replication, materialized views, cost tuning. Exposure to observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, metrics and logging stacks, alerting platforms. Experience building product analytics or telemetry platforms, or with stream processing frameworks such as Flink or Spark. Client-side instrumentation - web or mobile SDK development, event capture, session and consent handling. AI skills Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency for IC4 - it applies to how you build and to what you build. Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other - catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt. Integrating LLM APIs into production features - and knowing when a model is the wrong tool for the job. Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores, and agent frameworks; familiarity with the Model Context Protocol is a plus. Exposing telemetry to AI agents through tool interfaces agents can use safely: predictable schemas, bounded results, clear error semantics, sane cost controls. Designing safeguards for non-deterministic components - retry logic, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - and hardening against latency spikes and hallucinated output reaching a customer. Instrumenting AI features in production and judging their quality from telemetry and evaluation rather than impressions.

 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

 The Role

As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

 What You'll Do

title: Expert Sr Manager, AI Engineering
description:
The Impact You'll Have 
 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

 The Role 
 The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

 What You'll Do 
 Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications. Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning Embedding generation and optimization Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword) Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain's Responsible AI standards Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency Relevance and precision/recall Latency, throughput, and system-level performance Cost tracking and efficiency Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety 

 What We're Looking For 
 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval) Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection) ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops AI-Specific Tools Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads Comfort operating in high-ambiguity

description:

 What You'll Do 
 Design, build &maintain scalable automation frameworksusing Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and TestNG. Identify, document &triage defects with clear reproductionsteps, severity classification, and root-cause analysis. Mentor junior QAengineers and champion quality bestpractices across the engineering org.  What We'reLooking For 
 
 
 Must-Have Skills 
 3+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation in a productengineering environment. Strong proficiency with SeleniumWebDriver page object model, explicit waits, cross-browser testing. Solid experience with Cucumber(BDD) writing and maintaining feature files, step definitions, and hooks. Hands-on with TestNG test configuration, data providers, listeners, parallel execution, andreporting. Working knowledge of TDDprinciples and integrating tests into agile development workflows. Proficiency in at least oneprogramming language Java or Python preferred. Experience with CI/CDintegration and running tests in automated pipelines. Strong analytical thinkingwith an eye for edge cases, boundary conditions, and failure modes. Excellent communicationskills ability to clearly articulate test findings to technical andnon-technical audiences. 
 
 Nice to Have 
 Domain knowledge inPayments understanding of paymentflows, gateways, settlement, reconciliation, or fraud systems. Experience testing APIs with tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar. Familiarity with performance/ load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6). Exposure to cloudtesting environments (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm). Knowledge of securitytesting basics relevant to financial or transactional systems. Experience with mobileautomation (Appium or similar). 
 
 The Mindset WeValue 
 Beyond technical skills, we hirefor how you think and operate: Ownership mindset you treat quality as your personal responsibility, nota sign-off gate. Shift-left thinking you involve yourself in requirements and designdiscussions, not just execution phase. Bias for automation if something is tested manually more than twice, youask how to automate it. Collaborative you work with developers as partners, not adversaries,and build shared ownership of quality. Continuous improvement you regularly revisit your frameworks and practices,improving coverage, speed, and reliability.
