description:
The Impact You'll Have 
 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

 The Role 
 The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

 What You'll Do 
 Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications. Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning Embedding generation and optimization Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword) Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain's Responsible AI standards Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency Relevance and precision/recall Latency, throughput, and system-level performance Cost tracking and efficiency Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety 

 What We're Looking For 
 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval) Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection) ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops AI-Specific Tools Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads Comfort operating in high-ambiguity

Job Description 
 Job title: Senior Software Engineer 
 About SailPoint: 
 SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job no more, no less.
 About the role: 
 Want to be on a team that full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate? Want to make an impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team does just that. Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS.
 SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer with a strong API(REST/GraphQL) development/design background with a flair for programming in java (and Go desired) with a demonstrated history of learning, passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable, observable microservices for enterprise-grade, multi-tenant SaaS products. The position will be part of Identity Security Cloud Business Services group that develops governance features - Access Certifications, Access Request & Approvals, Password Management and Separation of Duties to connect and centrally control access to every application. As part of this team, we are defining the API management strategy for the range of SaaS products, and bring uniformity to the API creation across all teams, adopting diverse cloud-native technologies (persistence, messaging, analytical processing – to name a few) and enabling the product to scale seamlessly while providing a performant user experience. You'll work with teams that are passionate about continuous improvement and agility in a fast-paced environment. 
 Responsibilities  Drive the planning, design, construction, and reviewing the construction of APIs. Drive the design, implementation, and deployment of efficient, maintainable, robust microservices to deliver medium-to-high complexity features. As a member of the API strategy team, you will collaborate with the services team and help your stakeholders follow the organization's strategy for designing, building, and maintaining APIs. Produce designs and rough estimates, and implement features based on product requirements. Collaborate with peers on designs, code reviews, and testing. Produce unit and end-to-end tests to improve code quality and maximize code coverage for new and existing features. Requirements  5+ years of professional software development experience with a demonstrated record of increasing responsibilities. 4+ years of experience in developing server-side, object-oriented programming in Java, Spring Boot, and associated frameworks. Experience in designing, implementing RESTful/GraphQL APIs for an API-first application architecture. Experience using cloud-native technologies from AWS/other cloud providers. Experience developing microservices in multi-tenant SaaS application. Experience using SQL/NoSQL, EKS, Kafka, Redis Experience using monitoring, alerting, visualization tools like Prometheus, Grafana Experience working with remote teams Great communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills Desired Professional experience in design/implementation of event-driven architecture. Experience writing software applications in Go What success looks like in the role 
 Within the first 30 days you will: Onboard into your new role, get familiar with our product offering and technology, proactively meet peers and stakeholders, set up your development environment. Seek to deeply understand business problems or common engineering challenges and develop feature and unit test it. By 90 days: Proactively implement different enhancements, defect fixes by interacting independently with different (sometimes  many ) stakeholders, architects and members of your team. Take a committed approach to contributing to different projects development alongside less experienced engineers on your team—there’s no room for ivory towers here. Is able to provide 12x7 on-call support during their day. By 6 months: Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to estimate and develop small to medium complexity features more independently. Lead projects with small group of 3-4 members. Participate in resource planning, backlog refinement activity. Occasionally serve as an analysis expert during escalations of systems issues that have evaded the ability of less experienced engineers to solve in a timely manner. Share support of critical team systems by participating in calls with customers, learning the characteristics of currently running systems, and participating in improvements. About SailPoint India and our Benefits: 
 Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. 
Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:  Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.  Company sponsored health-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents  Annual performance bonus  24 Leaves every year in addition, 10 holidays  Flexible Work hours

title: Salesforce OMS Developer
description:
We are seeking a Salesforce OMS Developer to design, configure, integrate, test, and support omnichannel order management solutions. Working with architects, analysts, integration teams, testers, and external partners, the role covers order capture, fulfilment, inventory, returns, refunds, and customer service processes. 
Key Responsibilities 
Configure and develop Salesforce OMS capabilities from approved designs and business requirements.
Implement the end-to-end order lifecycle: ingestion, validation, allocation, fulfilment, shipment tracking, cancellation, returns, exchanges, refunds, closure, and reconciliation.
Enable omnichannel fulfilment, including Ship-from-Warehouse, Ship-from-Store, and Buy Online Pick Up In Store.
Build and maintain integrations with eCommerce, POS, WMS, ERP, payment, tax, logistics, and customer service platforms.
Develop Apex, Lightning Web Components, flows, REST APIs, platform events, and integration services as required.
Configure data models, validation, permissions, queues, notifications, automation, and inventory synchronization.
Implement transformation, error handling, retries, monitoring, and reconciliation across integrations and data flows.
Write unit tests; support system, user acceptance, performance, deployment, and production testing; and resolve defects.
Prepare technical documentation, deployment notes, integration specifications, and runbooks.
Follow development, version control, code review, and release standards; contribute estimates, workshops, and knowledge transfer.
 Required Qualifications and Experience 
4+ years of Salesforce development experience, with hands-on Salesforce Order Management or comparable commerce/OMS platforms.
Strong hands-on expertise in implementing and managing OMS connectors and payment gateway adapters.
Strong skills in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flows, Platform Events, REST/SOAP APIs, data modelling, and asynchronous processing.
Experience delivering order lifecycle, fulfilment, returns, refunds, inventory, and payment-related processes.
Integration experience across eCommerce, POS, WMS, ERP, payment, tax, or logistics platforms.
Good knowledge of Salesforce security, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, queues, and environment management.
Experience with Git, Salesforce CLI, change sets, DevOps Center, or comparable CI/CD tools.
Proficiency in unit testing, Apex debugging, integration monitoring, production support, data mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and data quality.
Ability to collaborate effectively with architects, analysts, testers, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors.
Exposure to Salesforce Agentforce, such as building or configuring AI agent actions for order-related tasks.
Preferred Experience and Certifications
Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Service Cloud, or Data Cloud.
MuleSoft or comparable integration middleware.
Inventory and fulfilment platforms in retail, eCommerce, consumer goods, or logistics environments.
Salesforce Platform Developer I or II, Administrator, or B2C Solution Architect certification.
 Key Competencies 
Salesforce OMS configuration, Apex, Lightning Web Components, and automation.
API development, integration, inventory synchronization, and data processing.
Order fulfilment, returns, refunds, and payment orchestration.
Troubleshooting, unit testing, documentation, and production support.
Agile delivery, collaborative problem-solving, and clear stakeholder communication.

description:

The candidate will work closely with developers, technical leads, product teams, and UI/UX designers to validate application functionality and deliver high-quality software. The ideal candidate should have experience in manual testing, API testing, database validation, test case design, and automation testing, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Key Responsibilities Manual and Functional Testing Analyze business requirements and technical specifications to prepare test scenarios and test cases. Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end testing. Identify, document, track, and verify software defects. Validate application workflows, user interfaces, forms, reports, and business rules. Ensure test coverage across positive, negative, boundary, and exception scenarios. 
 API and Database Testing Test REST APIs using Postman or similar tools. Validate API requests, responses, status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling. Perform database testing and data validation using SQL and PostgreSQL. Verify data consistency across application modules and integrations. Test API integrations with third-party and enterprise systems.

Validate role-based access control, authentication, authorization, and session management. Identify potential application security issues and coordinate with development teams for resolution. Participate in defect triage, root-cause analysis, and release-readiness reviews. Prepare test reports, maintain test documentation, and communicate quality risks to stakeholders. 
 Team Collaboration Work closely with developers, business analysts, product teams, and technical leads. Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. Support UAT, production validation, and release testing. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 28 years of experience in software quality assurance and testing. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and the SDLC/STLC. Hands-on experience with manual testing, functional testing, regression testing, and integration testing. Experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools. Knowledge of SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL. Understanding of test case design, defect lifecycle, and bug-tracking tools such as Jira. Experience with test management and documentation. Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
 Good to Have Experience with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or other automation frameworks. Knowledge of Python, Java, or JavaScript for test automation. Experience with JMeter or other performance testing tools. Familiarity with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and application security testing. Experience testing enterprise applications, REST APIs, and complex business workflows. Exposure to BFSI, government, legal technology, or regulated enterprise applications. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies. 
 What We Offer Opportunity to work on enterprise-grade applications and real-world business use cases. Collaboration with an experienced engineering and product team. Exposure to API-driven systems, enterprise integrations, and modern application architectures. Opportunity to contribute to product quality and continuous improvement.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

 We are seeking a skilled Nutanix Security Engineer to design, implement, secure, and manage Nutanix infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Nutanix HCI, virtualization technologies, cybersecurity best practices, and cloud security. The role focuses on ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of enterprise infrastructure while maintaining compliance with organizational security standards. 
 
 Responsibilities

description:
Position Title: Enterprise Architecture - Senior Manager Architecture - GR - 40551-75745-1 - Job Family: IFT > IT Architecture Shift: 2nd Shift (India) Job Title Senior Manager Architecture Requirement Type Full-Time Employee Job Location Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurugram Job Level Senior Manager Hiring Manager Senior Director Technology Primary Skill Enterprise Architecture, Pharmacy Platforms, AI Spec-Driven Development Business iRx IDW Data Mgmt Individual Contributor / People Manager People Manager ABOUT ELEVANCE HEALTH Elevance Health is a leading health company in America dedicated to improving lives and communities and making healthcare simpler. It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability. Implementation: capability readiness, integration completeness, migration quality, cutover readiness, production stability, adoption, and business outcome realization. Engineering: cycle-time improvement, automation coverage, defect escape reduction, reliability, developer experience, and maintainability. AI SDD: specification coverage and traceability, governed AI adoption, reusable agent workflows, quality of generated artifacts, and validated productivity benefits. Organization: critical-skill coverage, leadership bench strength, team health, succession readiness, and growth of architecture and engineering capability. Delivery: predictable release support and governance compliance, intentionally weighted below architecture, implementation, engineering, and business outcomes. THE CARELON PROMISE Aligning with our brand belief of limitless minds are our biggest asset , we offer a world of limitless opportunities to our associates. title: Team Leader - IT Infrastructure (Storage Engineering)
description:
At Rocket India, youll lead enterprise storage engineering across on-premises and cloud environments, helping deliver secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure services that power critical business platforms. As a Team Leader IT Infrastructure, Storage Engineering, you’ll design, configure, monitor, and optimize storage, backup, archival, and data protection solutions while collaborating with infrastructure, database, application, network, security, and cloud engineering teams. This role is ideal for a hands-on infrastructure leader who combines deep storage expertise, automation mindset, operational discipline, and strong cross-functional collaboration. 
 About the Role 
 Configure, manage, monitor, and optimize enterprise storage, backup, archival, recovery, and data protection platforms. Support storage services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments with a focus on availability, performance, security, and scalability. Troubleshoot complex storage, connectivity, backup, recovery, and performance issues in partnership with server engineers, database administrators, application owners, network engineers, security teams, and cloud engineering teams. Monitor storage platform connectivity, capacity, resource utilization, latency, throughput, health, and performance trends. Perform capacity planning to support anticipated growth, business demand, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. Fulfill storage, backup, archival, recovery, and data protection requirements for internal systems, enterprise applications, and technology platforms. Support storage automation, self-service provisioning, and operational consistency through scripting, APIs, DevOps practices, and infrastructure as code. Produce and maintain architecture diagrams, operational procedures, technical standards, runbooks, and support documentation. Implement storage solutions in alignment with organizational security requirements, data protection standards, cloud security best practices, and operational controls. Collaborate with internal customers and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. Participate in an on-call rotation and provide support outside standard business hours when required. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that improve reliability, provisioning efficiency, observability, and operational resilience. 
 About You Minimum Qualifications 
 Experience designing, building, and operating object and cloud storage solutions using technologies such as Ceph, Amazon S3, and Amazon EBS. Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, including source control with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or OpenTofu. Programming, scripting, and automation experience using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Go, YAML, and Ansible. Experience developing APIs and automation for storage resource management, including self-service provisioning, platform upgrades, object-storage buckets, volumes, and file shares. Experience supporting Kubernetes environments such as K3s, RKE2, and Amazon EKS, including storage integration using Container Storage Interface drivers. Experience implementing storage solutions that align with security requirements, data protection standards, and cloud security best practices. Experience monitoring storage utilization, capacity, availability, latency, throughput, and related performance metrics. Ability to perform capacity planning and recommend infrastructure actions based on current utilization, growth patterns, and performance trends. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to collaborate across server, database, application, network, security, and cloud engineering teams. Excellent communication, time-management, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Analytical thinker with a structured and creative approach to problem-solving. Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and work flexible hours as required. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Working knowledge of enterprise storage protocols, network file systems, and connectivity concepts, including NVMe over Fabrics, Fibre Channel, SMB/CIFS, and NFS. Experience with enterprise storage and virtualization platforms such as NetApp FAS and ONTAP, Dell EMC Isilon/PowerScale and Unity, IBM FlashSystem 7300, and VMware ESXi 7.x/8.x. Knowledge of cloud storage services, cloud database platforms, and data warehousing technologies. Understanding of cloud security, encryption, access control, data protection, and storage security best practices. Understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, replication, business continuity, and recovery planning. Experience improving storage observability, operational runbooks, automation coverage, provisioning standards, and service reliability. Ability to guide technical discussions, support platform decisions, and contribute to infrastructure modernization initiatives. Experience working in a global technology environment with distributed teams and business-critical systems. 
 What You’ll Get 
 At Rocket India, you’ll work on enterprise infrastructure platforms that support secure, scalable, and reliable digital experiences across Rocket’s global ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented technology teams, gain exposure to modern storage, cloud, DevOps, automation, and Kubernetes practices, and contribute to high-impact infrastructure modernization. You’ll be part of a culture that values ownership, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and bold thinking. 
 About Us 
 Rocket India (registered as NSM Services Private Limited & Formerly Mr. Cooper) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Rocket Mortgage, LLC—the nation’s largest home loan originator and mortgage servicer—headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. As a core part of Rocket’s global ecosystem, Rocket India builds scalable technology platforms and digital solutions that simplify mortgage origination and servicing. Our teams work across Operations, Product, Technology, Innovation, and Customer functions to drive efficiency, enable smarter decisions, and support Rocket’s mission to “Help Everyone Home.” We are committed to providing a fair and inclusive workplace for all team members and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, religion, caste, disability, or gender identity, consistent with applicable Indian law, including the Constitution of India, the Code on Wages, 2019, the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, and the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and from all sections of society.”

description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here: At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry. Job Description: What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe 
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.   As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.   Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence. 
Job Profile Summary The Third Party Risk Senior Associate supports the day-to-day operations of the Third-Party Risk Management pillar within Consulting Quality & Risk Management. Based in Noida, this position will provide third-party risk management (TPRM) expertise to maintain and evolve Crowe Consulting’s TPRM program. The position will be responsible for supporting Consulting’s daily TPRM queue, operations, reporting, and process improvement while working on a team under the direction of the Consulting TPRM program leader. 
Key Responsibilities Provide support to Crowe Consulting partners and other leaders regarding third-party matters, including, but not limited to, risk assessments, Request for Proposal (RFP) support, and findings remediation. Proactively monitor TPRM requests and identify stalled, slow-moving, or stopped matters for resolution or escalation. Monitor the Q&RM mailbox and administer the day-to-day workflow, including the review, execution, triage, follow-up, and finalization of inquiries and requests. Partner with internal stakeholders—including Information Security, Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Risk Management, and business unit leaders—to ensure alignment on responses and supporting documentation. Assist in the preparation of TPRM-related reports, ensuring accurate data capture and up-to-date documentation. Maintain clear handoffs and documentation to support seamless coordination with U.S.-based team members. Help identify and implement improvements to third-party risk management processes, working with TPRM leadership to streamline workflows and reduce inefficiencies. Update policies and procedures and educate the Consulting team on key TPRM risk issues. Maintain insight into trends and changes in the TPRM landscape through industry insights, partnerships, and ongoing development.  Support firmwide risk management changes, including, but not limited to, technology transformation, process changes, and training and education.  Provide value-added recommendations and share best practices with the Consulting team. Support the Enterprise Risk Management program and additional risk domains, as required. 
Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree. Experience: Senior Associate: 3+ years of relevant experience, with a demonstrated ability to manage TPRM activities independently. Demonstrated problem-solving skills to identify quality, risk, and compliance issues and develop processes to prevent or detect future issues. Demonstrated professionalism and confidentiality when handling sensitive information. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining accuracy and quality. Team-oriented, with experience working with diverse teams. Ability to leverage available resources and contribute through others. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across teams, time zones, and levels of seniority. High attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, ServiceNow, and AI productivity tools. Willingness to participate in both routine Quality & Risk Management (Q&RM) tasks and strategic cross functional projects. US Collaboration: willingness to work 4–5 hours of daily live overlap with U.S. Eastern Time (EST/EDT) teams for standups, handovers, and real-time collaboration to start. Candidate must have reliable means of commuting to and from local office. 
Preferred Qualifications Experience working in the professional services or financial services industry. General knowledge of banking compliance. Experience working with commercially available TPRM and/or GRC solutions. Relevant professional certifications preferred. Experience in project management. Experience working in a global capability center or similar distributed operating model supporting U.S.-based stakeholders. 
Work Environment This role sits within a growing, fast-paced Third-Party Risk Management function supporting a high volume of consulting engagements. Priorities can shift quickly, and the Senior Associate should be comfortable balancing routine, standardized work with time-sensitive requests. The role is based in Noida, India, and works extended hours to provide coverage aligned with U.S. business-day overlap. US collaboration is required with shift flexibility possible upon demonstration of functional proficiency.   We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times. Our Benefits: 
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world. title: Sr Statistical Programmer 1
description:
Job Summary 
 To perform the lead programming role, lead continuous improvement in the programming function's operating systems and provide consultancy across the function 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Develop, test and execute SAS programs to produce and validate CDISC SDTM and ADaM datasets, tables, figures and listings (TFL). Perform review and provide guidance on the development of the clinical database specification, data transfer agreement/specification, specification of tables, figures and listings (TFL) shells. Develop and review specification for SDTM datasets and ADaM datasets for safety data, TFL shells and other specifications, e.g. patient profiles, OPS reports. Develop and review electronic data submission package (SDTM annotated CRF, define.xml, Study/Analysis Data Reviewers Guide) for high complexity studies. Serve as a programming project lead on a complex study (e.g. adaptive design, integrated safety/efficacy study) to distribute and oversee tasks for the programming team, communicate with internal and external clients, plan and execute delivery, and manage resources and competing project priorities effectively. Ensure budget and scope of project work remain aligned. Manage the study documentation flow as per Worldwide SOP and other procedural documentation including timely document submission to eTMF. Be able to describe and explain Worldwide documentation and eTMF requirements. Contribute to department process improvement including creating and testing standard SAS Macros, maintaining the required validation documentation. Provide consultancy to Clinical Data Managers, Statistical Programmers and Biostatisticians on programming, clinical and analysis data standards (CDISC) and electronic data submission requirements. Develop and provide Statistical Programmers with training and coaching on the Biostatistical Operations department process, infrastructure and tools, collaboration with other internal and external parties and the role of the statistical programmer. Develop knowledge of SAS (including BASE, GRAPH, MACRO, ODS, SQL) and other software applications (e.g. Excel, Visual Basic, Word). Develop regulatory standards knowledge in computer systems, systems validation, Good Clinical Practice, clinical data management, clinical/statistical reporting and regulatory submission requirements etc. Act as subject matter expert for internal and external quality audits and inspections. Ensure all activities performed by the study team are in compliance with Worldwide and sponsor quality requirements, relevant ICH and regulatory authority standards, e.g. FDA 21 CFR Part 11, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Act as a mentor for junior department members. Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. 
 
 Other Skills and Abilities 
 The job holder must be computer literate and numerate with a willingness to adapt to various computer systems. Hands-on expert level project statistical programmer experienced in providing programming leadership to projects. Statistical programming skills and knowledge across a broad range of applications together with key competencies in customer focus, delivering on commitments, building strong relationships, communicating and influencing, and embracing innovation and change. It is essential that the job holder to possess strong analytical skills and attentiveness to detail. 
 
 Requirements 
 Educated to degree level or equivalent. The jobholder has advanced SAS programming skills with expert knowledge in SAS/Macro, Proc Report and ODS. Good working knowledge in SAS/Graph, Proc SQL, SAS/STAT. Minimum 4 years of previous related experience. Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently. The company reserves the right to amend this job description in consultation with the employee to reflect changes in its organisational structure or to the job itself in line with emerging business needs. We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

title: Sr. AI/ML Engineer - SDLC
description:
Job Title: Sr. AI/ML Engineer - SDLC 
 Location: Bangalore, India (Hybrid) 
 Permanent - Full Time 
 About Us 
 Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the worlds largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa. Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience. Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology. 
 Cyncly & The Power of AI 
 At Cyncly, we believe in unlocking the power of AI to deliver highly personalized and extraordinary experiences for our customers and their clients. We are on a dynamic journey of seeking exceptional talent to add critical AI models and functionality to our products used by over 17,000 customers worldwide. This is opportunity to be a part of a collaborative team that fosters continuous learning and growth, where youll work on exciting data driven projects that redefine the Spaces for Living industry. AI is reshaping private and business life at an unprecedented speed, and Cyncly is committed to leading the charge in delivering new sources of value for our customers. 
 Availability between 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST is required to support collaboration with our global teams. 
 About the role 
 We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer - SDLC to serve as a core technical builder to drive adoption and excellence in AI-assisted development across our engineering organization. This role will empower developers and technical teams to leverage AI tools effectively, accelerating development velocity while maintaining code quality and engineering standards. 
 Key Position Responsibilities Include: 
 Design & Develop AI Solutions Build AI/ML and GenAI-powered tools to optimize SDLC stages (requirements, coding, testing, deployment, maintenance). Develop intelligent systems for code generation, review, testing automation, defect prediction and democratizing large respos for new users. Improve Engineering Productivity Identify bottlenecks in development workflows and implement AI-driven optimizations. Reduce cycle time through automation and intelligent decision-support systems. GenAI & LLM Integration Design and implement solutions using LLMs (e.g., GPT and open-source models) for code assistance, documentation generation, test case generation, and end-to-end application or feature development from PRDs. Platform & Tooling Development Build reusable AI agents, APIs, and internal tools that can be adopted across engineering teams. Integrate AI solutions with existing DevOps tools, including CI/CD pipelines, issue-tracking systems, and version-control platforms. Data & Model Engineering Work with structured and unstructured engineering data, including code repositories, logs, and tickets. Fine-tune models and develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines where required. Governance & Best Practices Ensure responsible AI usage, model performance monitoring, and security compliance. Establish standards and best practices for AI-assisted software development. 
 Required Experience and Qualifications: Bachelor s/master s in computer science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field. 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with strong exposure to AI/ML. Proven experience building AI/ML or GenAI-based products. Strong polyglot programming skills (Python, Java, c# etc) and ability to adapt to various launguage ecosystems. Hands-on experience with:LLMs (OpenAI, Hugging Face, etc.), Prompt engineering and evaluation, RAG architectures and vector databases. Experience with Agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, or LangChain). Hands-on experience utilizing, evaluating, and fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, GLM) to automate key SDLC workflows is a strong advantage. Familiarity with frameworks like vLLM or Ollama. Solid understanding of software architecture, system design and modern DevOps practices. Proven Experience with ASTs (Abstract Syntax Trees) and code-parsing tools like Tree-sitter or LSP (Language Server Protocols). Hands on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j, Arango DB or similar) and their application in Knowledge Graphs or GraphRAG. 
 Core Competencies: Measurable reduction in SDLC cycle time. Increased developer productivity and efficiency. Improved code quality and reduced defect leakage. High adoption of AI tools across engineering teams. 
 Working for Us 
 At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect. Here, you ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth. We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together. If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

description:

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions . The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking. As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations. This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Delivery Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams. Provide technical leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production deployment. Partner closely with Salesforce Architects to translate architectural vision into scalable and maintainable technical solutions. Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements. Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution. Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews. Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks. Solution Design & Development Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting the organizations Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform. Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Platform, and Agentforce capabilities. Build intelligent service experiences utilizing Agentforce, AI-driven workflows, conversational experiences, and autonomous service capabilities. Design and develop complex solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, Integration Patterns, and Salesforce APIs. Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency. Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices. Team Leadership & Mentoring Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support. Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team. Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges. AI & Platform Innovation Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations. Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences. Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency. Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making. Required Qualifications Must Have 7 to 10 years of Salesforce platform experience with at least 2-3 years in a technical lead role. Strong hands-on expertise across: Service Cloud Sales Cloud Experience Cloud Salesforce Platform Deep technical expertise in: Apex Lightning Web Components (LWC) Salesforce Flows SOQL/SOSL Platform Events Integration Patterns REST/SOAP APIs Salesforce Security Model Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs. Experience leading and mentoring development teams. Experience working alongside solution architects and enterprise architects. Proven ability to drive technical decision-making and delivery governance. Strong understanding of: Data Architecture Security & Sharing Models DevOps & CI/CD Release Management Application Lifecycle Management Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments. Strong stakeholder communication and leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions. Experience with: CMDB IT Asset Management (ITAM) Service Catalog Enterprise Operations Management Hands-on experience with MuleSoft and API Management. Experience working in global delivery models. Salesforce Platform Developer I & II Certifications. Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect Certification. Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certifications. Added Advantage Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce. Experience building Conversational AI and autonomous service experiences. Exposure to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts. Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud. Experience delivering Digital Transformation and Enterprise Automation initiatives. Knowledge of Service Operations, ITIL, or Enterprise Service Management frameworks. What We Are Looking For We are seeking professionals who: Think like technical leaders while remaining hands-on contributors. Can successfully lead teams while maintaining a strong engineering mindset. Are comfortable partnering with architects and influencing platform strategy. Enjoy solving complex enterprise-scale technology challenges. Can balance delivery excellence, innovation, governance, and stakeholder expectations. Are passionate about Agentforce, AI, Conversational Platforms, and Intelligent Automation. Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and strong decision-making capabilities. Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments. Why Join Us Lead the technical delivery of a strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform. Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and Enterprise Automation. Influence platform architecture and engineering direction. Lead and mentor a high-performing Salesforce engineering team. Collaborate with architects, integration specialists, AI engineers, and business leaders. Accelerate your career toward Solution Architect and Engineering Leadership pathways. Be part of a rapidly growing organization where innovation and impact are valued. Join Us If you are a seasoned Salesforce professional with a passion for technical leadership, team mentoring, enterprise-scale solution delivery, and AI-driven innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future of Conversational Agentic ITSM on Salesforce . This role offers the opportunity to combine technical excellence, people leadership, and architectural influence while shaping a transformative platform that redefines enterprise service management.
