description:
Position Title: Enterprise Architecture - Senior Manager Architecture - GR - 40551-75745-1 - Job Family: IFT > IT Architecture Shift: 2nd Shift (India) Job Title Senior Manager Architecture Requirement Type Full-Time Employee Job Location Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurugram Job Level Senior Manager Hiring Manager Senior Director Technology Primary Skill Enterprise Architecture, Pharmacy Platforms, AI Spec-Driven Development Business iRx IDW Data Mgmt Individual Contributor / People Manager People Manager ABOUT ELEVANCE HEALTH Elevance Health is a leading health company in America dedicated to improving lives and communities and making healthcare simpler. It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability. Implementation: capability readiness, integration completeness, migration quality, cutover readiness, production stability, adoption, and business outcome realization. Engineering: cycle-time improvement, automation coverage, defect escape reduction, reliability, developer experience, and maintainability. AI SDD: specification coverage and traceability, governed AI adoption, reusable agent workflows, quality of generated artifacts, and validated productivity benefits. Organization: critical-skill coverage, leadership bench strength, team health, succession readiness, and growth of architecture and engineering capability. Delivery: predictable release support and governance compliance, intentionally weighted below architecture, implementation, engineering, and business outcomes. THE CARELON PROMISE Aligning with our brand belief of limitless minds are our biggest asset , we offer a world of limitless opportunities to our associates. title: Senior Engineer-Production and Testing
description:
Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Engineer Production & Testing with 15+ years of hands-on experience in the manufacturing and testing of power and distribution transformers. The ideal candidate will own day-to-day shop-floor production and the transformer test bay, ensuring output meets production schedules, quality standards, and customer/third-party test requirements. The role demands strong practical command of the full manufacturing sequence and of routine, type, and special testing, along with close coordination with the design, quality, planning, and stores functions. 
 Key Responsibilities Production Plan, execute, and supervise daily shop-floor production across core cutting, coil winding, core-coil assembly, drying (vacuum/VPI), tanking, and final assembly, in line with the production schedule and released drawings. Interpret General Arrangement (GA), core, winding, and tank/fabrication drawings, GTPs, and process sheets released by the design office, and translate them into accurate shop-floor execution. Achieve daily and monthly production targets through effective manpower deployment, shift planning, and line balancing. Monitor in-process quality at each manufacturing stage and ensure adherence to work instructions, process parameters, and applicable IS/IEC standards. Coordinate with design, quality, production planning, stores, and procurement to ensure material availability, smooth WIP flow, and timely resolution of shop-floor bottlenecks. Drive productivity improvement, cycle-time reduction, and optimal utilisation of raw materials (CRGO, copper/aluminium conductors, insulation, oil), minimising scrap and rework. Implement and sustain 5S, Kaizen, housekeeping, and shop-floor safety practices. 
 Key Responsibilities Testing Plan and conduct routine, type, and special tests as per IS 2026 / IEC 60076 — including turns ratio, winding resistance, insulation resistance, no-load and load losses, impedance, temperature rise, applied/induced overvoltage, and impulse tests, as applicable to the plant range. Conduct routine and acceptance tests in the presence of third-party inspection agencies and customer witnesses (CPRI / third-party) — a priority requirement of this role. Operate and supervise the test bay, ensuring correct test setups, instrument readiness, and full compliance with test-safety protocols. Maintain calibration status, test records, and traceability for all measuring and test instruments. Prepare, review, and finalise test reports, ensuring conformity with GTP and customer specifications before dispatch clearance. Diagnose test failures, drive root-cause analysis with production and design, implement corrective/preventive action, and re-test. 
 Required Skills & Expertise Strong hands-on experience across the complete transformer manufacturing process — core cutting, coil winding, core-coil assembly, drying/VPI, tanking, and final assembly. In-depth practical knowledge of transformer testing — routine, type, and special tests, test-bay operation, and test instrumentation. Ability to read and interpret GA, core, winding, and tank/fabrication drawings, GTPs, and customer technical specifications. Sound working knowledge of relevant standards: IS 2026, IEC 60076, IS 1180, CBIP guidelines, and ANSI, as applicable. Good understanding of raw materials — CRGO steel, copper/aluminium conductors, insulation materials, and transformer oil. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause-analysis skills for production and test-floor issues. Manpower management, shift planning, and production-planning capability. Familiarity with quality management systems (ISO) and shop-floor improvement tools (5S, Kaizen). Strong communication and cross-functional coordination skills (production, quality, testing, design, procurement). Leadership ability to guide shop-floor teams, technicians, and junior engineers. 
 Qualifications B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering (Mandatory); M.E./M.Tech or Diploma with extensive relevant experience considered. 15+ years of relevant experience in power/distribution transformer production and testing , with a significant portion in a factory/test-bay environment. Prior hands-on experience in a transformer manufacturing plant is strongly preferred. 
 Key Attributes Detail-oriented with strong ownership of production targets and test integrity. Comfortable working on the shop floor and in the test bay. Proactive, hands-on problem solver who performs under production timelines. Strong team player with the ability to lead technicians and mentor junior engineers.

title: Data & AI Scientist
description:
We are looking for a skilled Data & AI Scientist to join our Technology team. 
 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Statistical Analysis, A/B Testing and Generative AI/LLMs, with the ability to transform complex data into actionable business insights. You will develop, evaluate and deploy machine learning and AI solutions that improve pricing strategies, customer recommendations and operational efficiency. You will work closely with engineering, product, commercial and operational teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, validate and deploy predictive machine learning models for pricing optimization, personalized recommendations and operational efficiency. Analyze large datasets to identify customer behavior patterns, booking trends, anomalies and business opportunities. Design and evaluate A/B tests, hypothesis tests and statistical experiments to support data-driven decision-making. Collaborate with data engineers and software engineers to integrate ML models into production systems. Monitor deployed model performance, adoption and business impact. Develop meaningful insights, dashboards and recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Apply statistical methods to evaluate model effectiveness, uncertainty, bias and practical significance. Explore Generative AI and LLM capabilities to improve business processes and data science workflows. Promote responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security and output validation. Lead data science initiatives from problem definition through implementation and business impact assessment. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications 
 Strong hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, manipulation and machine learning. Excellent SQL skills and experience working with relational databases. Practical experience developing, evaluating and deploying Machine Learning models. Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, hypothesis testing and A /B experimentation. Experience with predictive modeling, recommendation systems or related ML algorithms. Understanding of data warehousing concepts and data platforms. Working knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) and responsible AI practices. Ability to translate business requirements into data science solutions with measurable outcomes. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience collaborating with cross-functional engineering, product and business teams. 
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Seaborn or similar visualization tools. Exposure to pricing optimization, customer analytics or recommendation systems. Experience applying AI tools to improve data analysis, model development and documentation. Understanding of customer behavior, commercial performance and operational analytics. 
 Ideal Candidate 
 We are looking for someone who can independently understand business problems, build reliable ML/AI solutions, critically evaluate experiments and communicate insights that influence business decisions. The candidate should combine strong technical expertise with commercial awareness, stakeholder collaboration and ownership of end-to-end data science initiatives. 
 Key Skills 
 Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Data Science, Predictive Modeling, Statistical Analysis, A/B Testing, Hypothesis Testing, Generative AI, LLM, Recommendation Systems, Data Analytics, Data Visualization, Power BI, Tableau, Data Warehousing, Model Deployment, Customer Analytics, Experimentation.

title: SR Systems Engineer - Medical Devices
description:
The Senior Systems Engineer sits within the New Product Development (NPD) function and operates as a strategic technical partner across the full product lifecycle. This is not a narrowly scoped component-level role; it demands the ability to hold system-level thinking alongside granular engineering detail translating ambiguous customer and stakeholder needs into structured, traceable requirements, and then shepherding those requirements through design, integration, verification, and validation. At its core, this position bridges component-level expertise with system-level thinking: understanding how individual parts behave under manufacturing stress, through final assembly, and ultimately within the human body during clinical deployment. Engineers in this role are expected to use simulation, production intelligence, and structured risk methods not as compliance checkboxes, but as genuine tools for accelerating innovation and improving manufacturing yield. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Requirements Management : Development and management of Functional, Non-functional, and Interface Requirements. Creation of Customer Requirement Specifications at System, Subsystem, and Component levels. Body of Knowledge (BoK) Development: Ability to define, structure, and draft a Systems Engineering Body of Knowledge capturing domain standards, methods, tools, and best practices — to serve as a living reference framework for the engineering organization Risk Management & Quality: Lead PFMEA and DFMEA activities; maintain structured risk registers throughout the program lifecycle. Proactively identify system-level risks and drive mitigation strategies. Apply historical production data and manufacturing learning to early-stage design decisions. System Architecture : The engineer will define and own system architecture for medical device platforms, establishing functional decomposition, interface definitions, and design trade-off strategies that ensure scalability, reuse, and manufacturability across product families. Production Intelligence Analysis: Mine ERP data to identify yield patterns, change order trends, and process gaps and feed that information back to Engineering. Legacy Learning Integration: Systematically analyze previously released products to extract process improvements that prevent recurring issues in new launches Systems Level Thinking : Understand and articulate how components behave from manufacturing stress through entire final assembly, deployment in human body, expansion in different therapy cavity - including torque, pressure, voltage, and insulation property interactions across the full system. Develop deep understanding of deliverable differences across sites and the technical reasoning behind process variations. Cross-Assembly Knowledge : Develop cross-product-family expertise across catheters, ground wires, and machined components — identifying system-level reuse opportunities and integration insights across manufacturing sites. Technical mentoring: Coach and mentor engineers in structured systems thinking, validation strategy, and data-driven decision making — supporting capability development aligned to the Systems Engineering Maturity Roadmap Customer Centric: Participates actively in customer-facing technical discussions, contributing system-level insights that demonstrate product value and support requirements clarification. Skill Area 
 Specific Competencies Simulation and Modeling 
 FEA, multi-physics simulation, CAD-based analysis Production Data Analysis 
 ERP data mining, yield analytics, process gap identification Requirements Engineering 
 Functional, Non-Functional, and Interface Requirements authoring; Requirements decomposition at System, Subsystem, and Component levels, RTM ownership Risk and Quality Methods 
 DFMEA, PFMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, CAPA Regulatory Frameworks 
 ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 Product Development Process 
 Lean PD gate processes (G0–G5). Alignment of gate milestones with FMEA, simulation, and requirements deliverables Systems Engineering Frameworks 
 INCOSE best practices, SEBoK principles Digital & AI Tools 
 AI-enabled FMEA tools, simulation platforms, ERP data analytics, digital twin awareness 
 EDUCATION & CRITICAL EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering ,Mechatronics or related engineering discipline. 8–12 years of progressive experience in systems engineering, preferably within medical devices or other regulated industries such as aerospace or automotive Proven track record of influencing cross-functional teams and driving measurable engineering improvements using production data and risk analysis Well versed with AI tools. Nice to Have - INCOSE Associate or Certified Systems Engineering Professional (ASEP/CSEP) certification or any Requirements Engineer certification. Nice to Have - AI-enabled FMEA tools, simulation platforms, ERP data analytics, digital twin awareness LEADERSHIP AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS Proven ability to influence cross-functional and globally distributed teams without direct authority — using technical credibility and data rather than organizational hierarchy Strong technical communication skills: capable of presenting complex system behavior and data-driven recommendations to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders Customer-facing experience: ability to translate customer application needs into system specifications and participate in technical validation discussions Proactive, system-level problem-solving orientation

Key Skills: Automation,ISO 13485,Architecture,DFMEA,PFMEA,Interfaces,ERP,FEA

description:

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Title: Regional Medical Expert (RME), Ophthalmology Reporting & Function Function: Medical Reporting Line: Reports to the RME Lead Location: Delhi, Hyderabad and Chennai (Dedicated in-field, 60-70% travel time) Purpose Statement The Regional Medical Expert is a trusted, externally focussed, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key customers over a meaningful period of time, you will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, ensuring that Roche is a preferred partner in Ophthalmology. Your role is designed to maximize medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, and drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, and access to our ophthalmology portfolio. 
 
 Core Accountabilities A. Contributing with Medical Expertise Medical Expertise: Proactively contribute strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within Ophthalmology to inform the differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally, and reflect an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact. B. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: Execute an HCP and account engagement plan aligned with cluster and pan-India medical strategy. Spend the majority of your time proactively engaging with external customers, KOLs, and other key stakeholders as partners in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. Medical Partnership & Education: Build peer-to-peer scientific relationships with HCPs, KOLs, and relevant ophthalmology specialists. Provide current, high-quality Medical Education and support advisory boards, scientific meetings, and institutional forums. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional Scientific Exchanges to foster physician confidence. Insight Generation: Systematically identify, capture, analyze, and translate external scientific and clinical practice insights from the field. Share these strategic, actionable recommendations directly with internal stakeholders, including DAMLs, MEs, and MCL. C. License to Operate & Operational Excellence Adherence to Standards: Ensure all activities, including customer engagements and research projects, are conducted in strict compliance with Roche SOPs, UCPMP, local regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP). D. Evidence Generation Evidence Strategy Implementation: Collaborate with DAMLs and MEs to proactively identify local differentiating evidence gaps and facilitate real-world evidence (RWE) opportunities, including registries, observational studies, and externally submitted Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS). Clinical Development Support: Support the identification and assessment of potential trial sites and active investigators. Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations to provide proactive input on feasibility and strategic site selection to aid in clinical study execution. Competencies, Experience & Qualifications Qualifications & Experience: Education: Advanced degree (MBBS, MD, PharmD, PhD, or MPharm) with a strong scientific foundation. Experience: 2-4 years experience in Medical Affairs, clinical practice, or a related field. Prior field-based/MSL experience is preferred. Prior exposure to Ophthalmology, specifically Vitreo-Retinal, is highly advantageous. Knowledge: Deep understanding of clinical research, RWE, and the Indian healthcare environment. High willingness to travel (60-70% field time). Language: Fluency in English is essential. Core Competencies & Ethical Mindset: Customer Focus: Prioritizes the needs of patients and customers (HCPs/TAEs), ensuring all actions drive value and satisfaction. Strategic Acumen: Ability to think strategically, act with autonomy, and thrive in complex, cross-functional team environments. Digital Literacy: Possesses a basic level of AI literacy and a learner mindset that proactively integrates digital tools. Ensures human-in-the-loop oversight of AI-derived content. Collaborative Networker: Collaborates effectively as part of a multi-skilled team (squad) and proactively shares expertise across the organization to remove silos. title: Director International Operations (Logistics)
description:
Job Overview We are seeking a seasoned, high-caliber logistics leader for the role of Director – Cross-Border Operations. Based out of our Gurgaon headquarters, you will lead end-to-end international logistics operations for Delhivery, overseeing cross-border import and export shipments across key global trade lanes. This is a strategic and execution-intensive role. You will spearhead the expansion of our international freight network by launching new country corridors and deferred air economy products, while driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships. This position owns P&L, SLA compliance, and operational efficiency for both air and ocean freight verticals. Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End International Logistics Operations Lead end-to-end international logistics operations, managing and optimizing cross-border import and export shipments across global trade lanes. Supervise daily workflows for inbound and outbound cargo, ensuring smooth execution across origin handling, international linehaul, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery. Implement robust monitoring systems to track shipments, proactively resolve operational exceptions, and ensure high on-time delivery rates. Should be able to create and manage dashboards  Hold reviews internally with cross functional teams and externally with partners in destination country Should be able to design using BI tools and define metrics internally and for partners 2. Network Expansion & Product Development Spearhead the physical and operational expansion of Delhivery's international freight network by identifying and launching new country corridors. Design, launch, and scale deferred air economy products to offer competitive, cost-effective cross-border shipping options to e-commerce, SME, and enterprise clients. Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational readiness criteria for all newly launched corridors and lanes. 3. Strategic Partnerships & Carrier Management Identify, negotiate with, and onboard key global partners, including freight forwarders, customs house agents (CHAs), customs brokers, and commercial airlines/ocean carriers. Build and maintain strong strategic alliances to secure capacity commitments, preferential rate structures, and reliable transit times during peak and non-peak seasons. Manage partner performance SLAs, conducting regular reviews to ensure compliance with Delhivery's high operational standards. 4. P&L & SLA Compliance Management Take complete financial ownership of the Air and Ocean freight verticals, managing P&L, cost optimization, and overall unit economics (e.g., cost-per-kilogram and route margins). Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Transit Turnaround Time (TAT), On-Time Delivery (OTD), Customs Clearance timelines, and first-contact dispute resolution. Control and minimize operational exceptions such as terminal storage costs, demurrage, detention fees, and flight offloads. 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Tech Enablement Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Sales, Business Development, Technology, and Legal/Compliance to support business growth and process standardization. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to build scalable, automated, and technology-driven processes for tracking, billing, and customs documentation. Ensure 100% adherence to international trade laws, customs regulations, aviation security standards, and safety compliances. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience & Education Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, Engineering, or a related field. Leadership: Minimum of 3+ years in a senior supervisory or managerial role directly overseeing air/ocean freight operations, partner management, or international linehaul. Core Competencies Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of air/ocean freight operations, global trade lanes, Incoterms 2020, customs clearance regulations, and HAWB/MAWB rules (aligned with our Global Air Freight Operations). Commercial & Financial Acumen: Strong experience managing P&L, negotiating complex commercial contracts, and optimizing unit economics. Analytical Rigor: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets for tracking operations, data analysis, and building performance dashboards. title: AM-Taxation
description:
Job purpose: To support and independently manage day-to-day Direct Taxation and TDS compliances, including timely filing of TDS returns, reconciliation of books with statutory returns, preparation and response to Income Tax notices, tax data analysis, and coordination with internal teams and consultants. The role will also require a working understanding of GST and other indirect tax matters to support the overall Taxation function. 
 Primary responsibilities: 1. TDS Compliance & Return Filing • Ensure timely preparation and filing of quarterly TDS/TCS returns within statutory due dates. • Review TDS applicability and rates on various payments such as rent, professional fees, contractor payments, commission, interest and other business expenses. • Reconcile TDS deducted in books with TDS returns before filing. • Coordinate for correction/revised TDS returns wherever required. Monitor TDS challans, deductions, balances and statutory payment status. • Support issuance and reconciliation of Form 16/16A and other TDS certificates. 
 2. Books vs. Return Reconciliation Perform regular reconciliation between books of accounts and TDS returns. • Identify differences in TDS deduction, vendor PAN, amount, section, rate and challan details. • Reconcile TDS/TCS balances with Form 26AS/AIS/TIS, wherever applicable. Coordinate with Accounts, Payroll, Procurement and other departments for resolution of reconciliation differences. • Maintain proper reconciliation workings and supporting documents for audit and assessment purposes. 
 3. Income Tax Notices & Assessments • Monitor and maintain records of Income Tax notices, communications and proceedings. • Prepare data, reconciliations and supporting documents required for responding to Income Tax notices. • Coordinate with tax consultants and internal stakeholders for preparation and submission of replies. Assist in matters relating to TDS defaults, demands, assessments and other Income Tax proceedings. Track notice-wise status, due dates, submissions and closure of outstanding matters. Maintain a proper Income Tax Notice & Litigation Tracker. 
 4. Direct Tax Compliance & Taxation Support Assist in preparation of advance tax, self-assessment tax and tax computation workings. Support preparation of tax audit and income-tax-related schedules and information. Assist in computation and reconciliation of current tax and other direct tax-related balances. • Support statutory, internal and tax audits by providing required information and documents. • Keep track of amendments and notifications under the Income-tax Act, Rules and applicable TDS provisions. 
 5. GST / Indirect Tax Knowledge Possess working knowledge of GST provisions, GST returns and basic ITC concepts. Understand the interaction between GST and direct tax/TDS transactions wherever applicable. • Assist the Taxation Team in reconciliation and analysis of GST-related data when required. • Coordinate with the GST team for common tax data, vendor details and reconciliation requirements. Develop working knowledge of GST notices, compliance requirements and relevant provisions. 
 Required Skills: • Good knowledge of TDS/TCS provisions and Income-tax Act. • Practical experience in TDS return preparation and filing. • Strong reconciliation skills Books vs. TDS Returns vs. 26AS/AIS/TIS. • Experience in handling/preparing data for Income Tax notices and assessments. • Working knowledge of GST and indirect taxation. • Good knowledge of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS and reconciliation techniques. • Good analytical and problem-solving skills. • Ability to coordinate with internal departments and external consultants

title: ADME Scientist
description:
ADME Scientist, ADME/IVB Profiling team (ADME - Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, and Excretion) (IVB - In Vitro Bioanalysis, often referred to as in vitro DMPK (Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics) 
 Job description 
 About the role 
 We are seeking a ADME scientist to growth our compound Profiling team (full time role). Specialised in DMPK of small molecule therapeutics, the ideal candidate will have a proven track record in developing ADME methods, profiling compounds in ADME assays and executing PK studies supporting drug projects at Discovery & PreClinical stage. As a key member of Topia Profiling team, you will drive data quality & efficiency for Program execution. You will leverage your experience & expertise in wet lab activities as well as keeping ELN records up to date. This role is part of Topia own capabilities in delivering drug pipeline of internal and partnered projects while having an impact on expanding Topia Tech Infrastructure. This Ahmedabad-based position reports directly to ADME/IVB Profiling Senior Manager. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Experimental Design & Execution 
 Conduct in vitro ADME assays and in vivo DMPK studies, including aqueous solubility (UV/HPLC/LCMS), permeability, metabolic stability, protein binding, CYP inhibition, and CYP profiling. Develop and validate analytical methods (LC-MS/MS, HPLC) for drug quantification. Perform pharmacokinetic and bioanalytical studies to characterize drug disposition. 
 Data Analysis & Interpretation 
 Perform data processing, statistical analysis, and interpretation of ADME and PK results. Provide scientific recommendations for candidate selection and dose regimen design. 
 Collaboration & Reporting 
 Coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams (e.g., chemistry, biology, clinical). Prepare clear, well-documented reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Act as Topia Scientific Excellences ambassador, promoting our culture of collaboration and inclusion. 
 Qualifications & Skills 
 PhD or Masters in Pharmacology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or related field. 3–5 years for entry-level; 7+ years for senior/principal scientist roles. Strong knowledge of drug metabolism pathways, ADME assay validation, optimization, and enzyme kinetics. Experience in running PK studies (in life and/or analytical phase) is a plus Proficiency with bioanalytical techniques (multimode readers, LC-MS/MS, HPLC). Familiarity with data analysis software and statistical tools. Understanding of regulatory guidelines (FDA, EMA) for bioanalytical method validation. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills. Excellent communicator (English) with the ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented global environment; strong analytical skills, record-keeping orientated and result-driven mindset Enthusiastic about external partnerships and customer-facing behaviour 
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary, including benefits Flexible working hours Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking AI innovations in Healthcare and strategic influence over the expansion of an AI-native TechBio organisation spearheading Precision Design of new drugs Collaborative culture with access to a global network of experts Professional development and involvement in high impact projects.

It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability. Implementation: capability readiness, integration completeness, migration quality, cutover readiness, production stability, adoption, and business outcome realization. Engineering: cycle-time improvement, automation coverage, defect escape reduction, reliability, developer experience, and maintainability. AI SDD: specification coverage and traceability, governed AI adoption, reusable agent workflows, quality of generated artifacts, and validated productivity benefits. Organization: critical-skill coverage, leadership bench strength, team health, succession readiness, and growth of architecture and engineering capability. Delivery: predictable release support and governance compliance, intentionally weighted below architecture, implementation, engineering, and business outcomes. description:
Position Title: Enterprise Architecture - Senior Manager Architecture - GR - 40551-75745-1 - Job Family: IFT > IT Architecture Shift: 2nd Shift (India) Job Title Senior Manager Architecture Requirement Type Full-Time Employee Job Location Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurugram Job Level Senior Manager Hiring Manager Senior Director Technology Primary Skill Enterprise Architecture, Pharmacy Platforms, AI Spec-Driven Development Business iRx IDW Data Mgmt Individual Contributor / People Manager People Manager ABOUT ELEVANCE HEALTH Elevance Health is a leading health company in America dedicated to improving lives and communities and making healthcare simpler. It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability. Implementation: capability readiness, integration completeness, migration quality, cutover readiness, production stability, adoption, and business outcome realization. Engineering: cycle-time improvement, automation coverage, defect escape reduction, reliability, developer experience, and maintainability. AI SDD: specification coverage and traceability, governed AI adoption, reusable agent workflows, quality of generated artifacts, and validated productivity benefits. Organization: critical-skill coverage, leadership bench strength, team health, succession readiness, and growth of architecture and engineering capability. Delivery: predictable release support and governance compliance, intentionally weighted below architecture, implementation, engineering, and business outcomes. description:
Job Description We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our outcome data pod. You will evaluate third-party consumer, business, panel and outcome data, and turn validated data into features for a household-level intelligence layer that powers audience and measurement use cases. This is an analysis-led role. You will test what a data provider s data actually delivers, using real samples, rather than relying on the provider s reported numbers. You need a solid grasp of how the consumer and business data ecosystem works, including identity resolution, data licensing and audience data. You will work closely with Data Engineering and report findings that are sourced, reproducible and clear to non-technical stakeholders.
 
 Key Responsibilities: Evaluate third-party outcome, panel and video data against real data samples. Measure match rate, label precision, geographic distribution, deduplication and bot quality, and viewership precision. Design and run match-rate testing to independently validate provider-reported figures, using both deterministic and probabilistic matching approaches. Map provider-specific schemas and data dictionaries into a shared feature taxonomy. Build feature definitions and data-quality checks for a feature store supporting a household embedding model of roughly 100 features. Document data-quality findings in a standard scorecard format, with a clear evidence trail that others can reproduce. Identify privacy and consent gaps in third-party data, such as unclear consent for ML training, and escalate them for legal review. Partner with Data Engineering to define the validated schema each data pipeline should deliver. Present findings and recommendations to business and technical stakeholders. Qualifications Must Have Skills 6+ years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, ideally in adtech, martech, data brokerage or programmatic/real-time platforms. Statistical analysis of sample and panel data: match-rate testing, deduplication and bot detection, and geographic (DMA-level) distribution analysis. Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn or equivalent) and SQL. Working knowledge of identity resolution: hashed PII, deterministic vs. probabilistic matching, and MAID, HEM and household-ID concepts. Experience matching and joining disparate datasets, including third-party consumer and business data. Experience evaluating third-party or panel data quality: data dictionary review, sample audits, provenance and overlap checks. Feature engineering for downstream ML and embedding use. Clear written communication of quantitative findings to non-technical stakeholders. Good to Have Experience with feature stores or embedding-based customer or household representations. Exposure to marketing and media measurement, telecom or advertising audience data. Familiarity with data clean-room platforms (Snowflake Data Clean Rooms, LiveRamp, Habu, InfoSum). Experience with Snowflake or Databricks. Working familiarity with CCPA and consent frameworks, enough to recognize gaps rather than adjudicate them.
