title: Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Unit Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early. In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend. We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds. Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules. 

 Responsibilities 
 As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately. Synthetic Testing: Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan. So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today" and see what the AI says. Does the AI say yesDoes it calculate the early payment fee correctlyWhat if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spellingWhat if you type in a mix of Hindi and EnglishWhat if you pretend to be very angryDoes the AI still understand and stay politeYou will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly. LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain): The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to. If a customer types, "What is my balance", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters. As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI." You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks. Visualisations: Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen. Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations. Let\'s say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly. Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn\'t make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use. Product Switching: Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand." At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing. We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later. Conversation Flows: A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows. You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen. 
Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help" -> Arrow points to Box 2. 
Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3. 
Box 3: The system checks if the customer\'s phone number is verified. 
If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4. 
If No -> Arrow points to Box 5.

 About XpertDox XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. 
 Position Summary You will work on neural network models that read clinical documentation and predict medical codes. Your first job is diagnosis: finding out why these models get specific cases wrong, and testing fixes until one holds up. Once a fix is proven, you write it into production code that runs inside the automated coding pipeline. This is an individual contributor role with no team management. It suits someone who wants to understand model errors and fix them. It does not suit someone who wants to run experiments without shipping, or who works only in notebooks. 
 Key Responsibilities In this role you will: Own diagnosis of model errors on clinical text: find where predictions go wrong and trace each pattern to its root cause. Design experiments that test one specific fix at a time, and decide from the results whether the fix moves forward. Train, fine-tune, and evaluate neural network models for multilabel classification on clinical documentation. Improve precision on imbalanced classes, where a wrong code has a real cost. Write production Python that moves proven fixes into the automated coding pipeline. Explain the tradeoffs of a proposed change to the AI Team Lead before it touches a production model. Document every experiment: what you tried, what happened, and what you decided. 
 Required Qualifications At least 1 year of hands-on machine learning work outside coursework. Hands-on experience fine-tuning pretrained language models for text classification. Project work training deep learning models in Python. Experience with multilabel classification, including handling class imbalance. Production Python: code that runs inside a larger system, beyond notebook experiments. Strong debugging and root-cause skills: you can work out why a model or pipeline is behaving unexpectedly. Willing to act on partial evidence instead of waiting for exhaustive experiments. Explains tradeoffs clearly before making a change. Methodical and careful, because this work affects real claims. 
 Preferred Qualifications Making model predictions reliable enough for automated decisions. Adapting language models to specialized vocabulary. Taking a model from research prototype to production deployment. 
 Location and Schedule This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Noida must relocate to Noida before their start date. No travel is required.

title: Expert Sr Manager, AI Engineering
description:
The Impact You'll Have 
 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

 The Role 
 The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

 What You'll Do 
 Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications. Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning Embedding generation and optimization Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword) Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain's Responsible AI standards Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency Relevance and precision/recall Latency, throughput, and system-level performance Cost tracking and efficiency Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety 

 What We're Looking For 
 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval) Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection) ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops AI-Specific Tools Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads Comfort operating in high-ambiguity

title: Sr Quality Engineer
description:
We are looking for a passionateand detail-oriented Software Engineer in Quality Assurance (Automation) to joinour engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of buildingand scaling our test automation ecosystem owning quality end-to-end, fromtest design to continuous delivery pipelines. You'll work closely withdevelopers, product managers, and DevOps to ensure our products are robust,reliable, and release-ready at all times. 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Design, build &maintain scalable automation frameworksusing Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and TestNG. Own test strategy for assigned squads defining scope, coverage, and riskfrom requirements through production. Write BDD feature files (Gherkin) to enable collaboration between QA, Dev, andProduct stakeholders. Implement TDD practices writing tests before or alongside code to drivequality in development cycles. Integrate automatedsuites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins,GitHub Actions, or similar) for continuous feedback. Perform API testing and validate end-to-end user journeys across web andservices. Identify, document &triage defects with clear reproductionsteps, severity classification, and root-cause analysis. Mentor junior QAengineers and champion quality bestpractices across the engineering org. Continuously evaluate test health, flakiness, and coverage gaps iterating tokeep automation suite trustworthy. 
 
 What We'reLooking For 
 
 
 Must-Have Skills 
 3+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation in a productengineering environment. Strong proficiency with SeleniumWebDriver page object model, explicit waits, cross-browser testing. Solid experience with Cucumber(BDD) writing and maintaining feature files, step definitions, and hooks. Hands-on with TestNG test configuration, data providers, listeners, parallel execution, andreporting. Working knowledge of TDDprinciples and integrating tests into agile development workflows. Proficiency in at least oneprogramming language Java or Python preferred. Experience with CI/CDintegration and running tests in automated pipelines. Strong analytical thinkingwith an eye for edge cases, boundary conditions, and failure modes. Excellent communicationskills ability to clearly articulate test findings to technical andnon-technical audiences. 
 
 Nice to Have 
 Domain knowledge inPayments understanding of paymentflows, gateways, settlement, reconciliation, or fraud systems. Experience testing APIs with tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar. Familiarity with performance/ load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6). Exposure to cloudtesting environments (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm). Knowledge of securitytesting basics relevant to financial or transactional systems. Experience with mobileautomation (Appium or similar). 
 
 The Mindset WeValue 
 Beyond technical skills, we hirefor how you think and operate: Ownership mindset you treat quality as your personal responsibility, nota sign-off gate. You proactively identify risks, flag issues early, and seebugs as a systemic problem to solve. Shift-left thinking you involve yourself in requirements and designdiscussions, not just execution phase. Bias for automation if something is tested manually more than twice, youask how to automate it. Collaborative you work with developers as partners, not adversaries,and build shared ownership of quality. Continuous improvement you regularly revisit your frameworks and practices,improving coverage, speed, and reliability.

description:
About the Role Webnyay Private Limited is looking for a skilled QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, security, and performance of enterprise applications. The candidate will work closely with developers, technical leads, product teams, and UI/UX designers to validate application functionality and deliver high-quality software. The ideal candidate should have experience in manual testing, API testing, database validation, test case design, and automation testing, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Key Responsibilities Manual and Functional Testing Analyze business requirements and technical specifications to prepare test scenarios and test cases. Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end testing. Identify, document, track, and verify software defects. Validate application workflows, user interfaces, forms, reports, and business rules. Ensure test coverage across positive, negative, boundary, and exception scenarios. 
 API and Database Testing Test REST APIs using Postman or similar tools. Validate API requests, responses, status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling. Perform database testing and data validation using SQL and PostgreSQL. Verify data consistency across application modules and integrations. Test API integrations with third-party and enterprise systems. 
 Automation Testing Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools. Automate repetitive functional and regression test cases. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines where applicable. Identify opportunities to improve test coverage and reduce manual testing effort. 
 Performance, Security and Quality Support performance and load testing using tools such as JMeter or similar platforms. Validate role-based access control, authentication, authorization, and session management. Identify potential application security issues and coordinate with development teams for resolution. Participate in defect triage, root-cause analysis, and release-readiness reviews. Prepare test reports, maintain test documentation, and communicate quality risks to stakeholders. 
 Team Collaboration Work closely with developers, business analysts, product teams, and technical leads. Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. Support UAT, production validation, and release testing. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 28 years of experience in software quality assurance and testing. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and the SDLC/STLC. Hands-on experience with manual testing, functional testing, regression testing, and integration testing. Experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools. Knowledge of SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL. Understanding of test case design, defect lifecycle, and bug-tracking tools such as Jira. Experience with test management and documentation. Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
 Good to Have Experience with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or other automation frameworks. Knowledge of Python, Java, or JavaScript for test automation. Experience with JMeter or other performance testing tools. Familiarity with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and application security testing. Experience testing enterprise applications, REST APIs, and complex business workflows. Exposure to BFSI, government, legal technology, or regulated enterprise applications. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

title: Power BI SDET / Test Automation Engineer
description:
Role Summary We are looking for a Power BI SDET who combines strong manual testing fundamentals with a growing automation and AI-assisted quality engineering practice. You will own the quality of Power BI semantic models, reports, and data pipelines for lululemon's retail analytics, making sure the numbers business users rely on are accurate, performant, and trusted. You will also help shape how the team uses Microsoft Copilot (Power BI and Fabric) and agentic AI to validate reports, generate test assets, and speed up regression cycles, while testing the AI-driven experiences themselves. Key Responsibilities Manual and functional testing (core of the role) Design and execute test plans, cases, and exploratory sessions for Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models. Validate DAX measures, calculated columns, KPIs, and business logic against source systems and business definitions (sell-through, units per transaction, inventory turns, comp sales, margin, and similar). Perform data reconciliation between source systems (ERP, POS, e-commerce, warehouse) and the reporting layer. Test row-level security (RLS) and object-level security by persona, such as store manager, regional lead, merchandiser, and executive. Test slicers, drill-through, bookmarks, cross-filtering, tooltips, and visual behavior across browsers, devices, and the Power BI mobile app. Validate refresh behavior (scheduled and incremental), gateway connectivity, and data freshness. Log, triage, and track defects in Azure DevOps or Jira, with clear repro steps and business impact. Run UAT with business stakeholders and sign off on release readiness. Test automation Build automated data validation and regression suites using SQL, Python, and/or PySpark. Automate semantic model testing with DAX queries, Tabular Editor and Best Practice Analyzer rules, and the XMLA endpoint. Integrate automated checks into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) with Power BI deployment pipelines and Git-based source control (PBIP / TMDL). Automate UI and report smoke tests where practical (Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent). Establish performance baselines using Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, and Fabric capacity metrics. AI-infused quality engineering Copilot: Use Copilot in Power BI / Fabric to accelerate test design, DAX review, measure explanation, and report summaries, and independently verify its outputs. Testing AI outputs: Test Copilot-generated content (narratives, DAX suggestions, Q&A responses) for accuracy, hallucination, consistency, and security/data-exposure risks. Agentic AI: Apply agentic patterns, such as agents that generate test cases from requirements, run reconciliation checks, triage failures, or draft defect reports, with a human in the loop. Guardrails: Help define guardrails, evaluation criteria, and acceptance thresholds for AI-assisted analytics features. Responsible AI: Document responsible-AI practices for testing, including data privacy, prompt and output logging, and bias checks. Collaboration Work with BI developers, data engineers, product owners, and lululemon business stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment. Contribute to test strategy, definition of done, and quality gates for the analytics platform. Mentor junior testers on moving from manual to automated and AI-assisted approaches. Required Qualifications 5+ years in software or data testing, with substantial hands-on manual testing experience (functional, regression, exploratory, UAT). Practical experience testing Power BI reports and semantic models, including DAX, RLS, and refresh/deployment behavior. Strong SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation. Solid understanding of data warehousing and BI concepts (star schema, ETL/ELT, dimensions and facts, slowly changing dimensions). Experience with defect and test management tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, or Xray). Working knowledge of at least one scripting language, preferably Python, for test automation. Exposure to CI/CD concepts and Agile delivery. AI: Working knowledge of Copilot (Power BI, Microsoft 365, or GitHub Copilot) and a clear understanding of agentic AI concepts: agents, tools, orchestration, human-in-the-loop, and evaluation. Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with client stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Microsoft Fabric experience (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Dataflows Gen2, Pipelines, Direct Lake). Experience with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, ALM Toolkit, or Power BI REST/XMLA APIs. Hands-on experience with agent frameworks or tooling (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain) or prompt-based test generation. Experience with data quality frameworks (Great Expectations, dbt tests, Soda). Retail, e-commerce, or consumer brand analytics experience (merchandising, inventory, omni-channel, loyalty). Certifications: PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), AI-900 or AI-102, ISTQB. What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months) A documented, repeatable Power BI test strategy covering manual, automated, and AI-assisted validation. Measurable reduction in report defects reaching production and in regression cycle time. Automated data reconciliation checks running in the deployment pipeline. A governed approach to testing Copilot and AI-generated analytics, with defined accuracy and safety criteria. Stakeholder trust in the numbers, reflected in fewer "which number is right?" escalations. Tools and Technologies BI and data platform Power BI Desktop/Service, Microsoft Fabric, DAX, SQL Automation and scripting Python, PySpark, Playwright / Selenium Model and performance tooling Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, ALM Toolkit, Performance Analyzer DevOps and test management Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira / Xray AI and Copilot Copilot (Power BI, Fabric, GitHub, Copilot Studio), Azure AI Foundry

Proven experience in preventive quality management rather than inspection-focused quality control alone. Demonstrated success in quality risk assessment, supplier development, process improvement, and governance. Deep understanding of apparel manufacturing processes, garment construction, fabrics, trims, and finishing. Experience handling a broad portfolio of products across Apparel and Soft Home categories. Strong knowledge of Home Soft Textile products including bedding, curtains, cushions, throws, quilts, towels, and related categories. Ability to drive supplier ownership of quality through self-inspection and capability-building programs. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach. Preferred Experience Experience in trading companies, buying offices, or buying agencies will be a strong advantage. Knowledge of testing requirements including color fastness, shrinkage, performance testing, and product safety. Familiarity with social and environmental compliance standards such as BSCI, SEDEX, and ISO systems. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and reporting tools. Soft Skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills to effectively engage buyers, vendors, factories, and internal stakeholders. Detail-oriented, organized, and proactive with a continuous improvement mindset. Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. description:
Associate Network Security Engineer (Firewalls & WAF) Company: CDK Global Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India Experience Level: 1 Year to 3year About the Role As an Associate Network Security Engineer at CDK Global, you will help secure the infrastructure that powers our SaaS platforms for the automotive industry. In this role, you will focus on the day-to-day administration, tuning, and monitoring of Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) and Web Application Firewalls (WAF). You will work closely with senior engineers to implement security policies, analyze application traffic, and troubleshoot network connectivity issues, ensuring a secure and reliable environment for our applications. Key Responsibilities Firewall Administration: Assist in the configuration, deployment, and daily management of enterprise firewalls (such as Palo Alto Networks) to control internal and external network traffic. WAF & ASM Management: Configure and tune Web Application Firewalls and Application Security Management (ASM) policies to protect internet-facing applications against OWASP Top 10 threats, botnets, and layer 7 attacks. Policy Tuning & Optimization: Regularly review and optimize security policies and firewall rule sets to support Attack Surface Reduction initiatives and ensure least-privilege access. Network Troubleshooting: Apply foundational networking knowledge to troubleshoot traffic flow, VPN connectivity, and access issues across the enterprise network. Threat Monitoring & Response: Monitor security logs, investigate blocked traffic or anomalies, and work with application teams to resolve false positives while maintaining strict security postures. Documentation: Maintain accurate network diagrams, traffic flow documentation, and standard operating procedures for firewall and WAF deployments. Required Qualifications Experience: Approximately 2 years of hands-on experience in network security, network operations, or a related technical support role. Networking Knowledge: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, TCP/IP suite, routing protocols, DNS, DHCP, and VPN technologies. Firewall Fundamentals: Practical experience managing and configuring Next-Generation Firewalls (creating rules, NAT policies, and monitoring logs). WAF/ASM Concepts: General understanding of Web Application Firewalls, ASM modules, and web traffic security concepts (HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS termination, basic web vulnerabilities). Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities and a methodical approach to analyzing network traffic and security events. Preferred Skills Familiarity with network security frameworks like Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). Experience with ticketing and change management workflows. Industry certifications such as CompTIA Network+/Security+, CCNA, or vendor-specific firewall certifications (e.g., PCNSA).

Endpoint Management & Mobile Device Management (MDM)

 Were looking for a hands-on NOC Engineer who can also handle security monitoring and incidents. Youll monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across our AWS and Kubernetes environments, respond to security alerts, and automate repetitive work - thinking clearly under pressure and owning incidents end to end 
 Network / Cloud Operations (NOC) 
 Monitor the health, availability and performance of AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, applications and networks, 24x7 on a rotational basis. Act as L2 escalation point: triage, troubleshoot, debug and resolve incidents escalated from L1 or raised by monitoring tools. Analyze logs, metrics and traces to find root causes across compute, network, storage, database and application layers. Escalate to engineering, cloud and vendor teams with clear, complete technical context when needed. Tune alerts and dashboards to reduce noise and improve signal quality.  Security Operations (SOC)

Triage, investigate and classify security events; separate false positives from real threats. Execute first response on security incidents: containment, evidence collection, escalation and follow-up. Identify suspicious activity such as unauthorized access, IAM misuse, unusual network traffic, malware or data exfiltration indicators. Follow and improve security incident response playbooks. Support vulnerability management, access reviews and audit evidence requests.

Build auto-remediation, alert enrichment and ticket auto-creation workflows. Write and maintain runbooks, SOPs and knowledge base articles. Identify recurring issues and drive problem management to permanent fixes. 
 Incident, Ticketing and ITIL Process 
 Manage incidents, service requests, problems and changes in ticketing tools (e.g., Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Opsgenie). Meet SLAs for acknowledgement, response and resolution. Lead or support major incident bridges; provide clear status updates to stakeholders. Write post-incident reviews / RCAs with action items. Provide clean, documented shift handovers. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications

AWS fundamentals, observability tooling, and ITIL/ticketing experience are high priority. Kubernetes is medium-to-high priority; coding in any language is a plus.

 Hands-on security experience (SIEM tools, AWS security services, awareness of MITRE ATT&CK/OWASP Top 10) A track record of automating manual work (scripting or low-code/no-code) Working AWS knowledge (VPC, EC2, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.) and Kubernetes (EKS preferred) Strong troubleshooting ability and comfort with Linux CLI 3-6 years in NOC, SOC, cloud ops, or SRE/DevOps support, with ITIL and ticketing experience Bachelors degree in CS/IT/Electronics or equivalent experience

title: Team Leader - IT Infrastructure (Storage Engineering)
description:
At Rocket India, youll lead enterprise storage engineering across on-premises and cloud environments, helping deliver secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure services that power critical business platforms. As a Team Leader IT Infrastructure, Storage Engineering, you’ll design, configure, monitor, and optimize storage, backup, archival, and data protection solutions while collaborating with infrastructure, database, application, network, security, and cloud engineering teams. This role is ideal for a hands-on infrastructure leader who combines deep storage expertise, automation mindset, operational discipline, and strong cross-functional collaboration. 
 About the Role 
 Configure, manage, monitor, and optimize enterprise storage, backup, archival, recovery, and data protection platforms. Support storage services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments with a focus on availability, performance, security, and scalability. Troubleshoot complex storage, connectivity, backup, recovery, and performance issues in partnership with server engineers, database administrators, application owners, network engineers, security teams, and cloud engineering teams. Monitor storage platform connectivity, capacity, resource utilization, latency, throughput, health, and performance trends. Perform capacity planning to support anticipated growth, business demand, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. Fulfill storage, backup, archival, recovery, and data protection requirements for internal systems, enterprise applications, and technology platforms. Support storage automation, self-service provisioning, and operational consistency through scripting, APIs, DevOps practices, and infrastructure as code. Produce and maintain architecture diagrams, operational procedures, technical standards, runbooks, and support documentation. Implement storage solutions in alignment with organizational security requirements, data protection standards, cloud security best practices, and operational controls. Collaborate with internal customers and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. Participate in an on-call rotation and provide support outside standard business hours when required. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that improve reliability, provisioning efficiency, observability, and operational resilience. 
 About You Minimum Qualifications 
 Experience designing, building, and operating object and cloud storage solutions using technologies such as Ceph, Amazon S3, and Amazon EBS. Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, including source control with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or OpenTofu. Programming, scripting, and automation experience using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Go, YAML, and Ansible. Experience developing APIs and automation for storage resource management, including self-service provisioning, platform upgrades, object-storage buckets, volumes, and file shares. Experience supporting Kubernetes environments such as K3s, RKE2, and Amazon EKS, including storage integration using Container Storage Interface drivers. Experience implementing storage solutions that align with security requirements, data protection standards, and cloud security best practices. Experience monitoring storage utilization, capacity, availability, latency, throughput, and related performance metrics. Ability to perform capacity planning and recommend infrastructure actions based on current utilization, growth patterns, and performance trends. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to collaborate across server, database, application, network, security, and cloud engineering teams. Excellent communication, time-management, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Analytical thinker with a structured and creative approach to problem-solving. Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and work flexible hours as required. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Working knowledge of enterprise storage protocols, network file systems, and connectivity concepts, including NVMe over Fabrics, Fibre Channel, SMB/CIFS, and NFS. Experience with enterprise storage and virtualization platforms such as NetApp FAS and ONTAP, Dell EMC Isilon/PowerScale and Unity, IBM FlashSystem 7300, and VMware ESXi 7.x/8.x. Knowledge of cloud storage services, cloud database platforms, and data warehousing technologies. Understanding of cloud security, encryption, access control, data protection, and storage security best practices. Understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, replication, business continuity, and recovery planning. Experience improving storage observability, operational runbooks, automation coverage, provisioning standards, and service reliability. Ability to guide technical discussions, support platform decisions, and contribute to infrastructure modernization initiatives. Experience working in a global technology environment with distributed teams and business-critical systems. 
 What You’ll Get 
 At Rocket India, you’ll work on enterprise infrastructure platforms that support secure, scalable, and reliable digital experiences across Rocket’s global ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented technology teams, gain exposure to modern storage, cloud, DevOps, automation, and Kubernetes practices, and contribute to high-impact infrastructure modernization. You’ll be part of a culture that values ownership, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and bold thinking. 
 About Us 
 Rocket India (registered as NSM Services Private Limited & Formerly Mr. Cooper) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Rocket Mortgage, LLC—the nation’s largest home loan originator and mortgage servicer—headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. As a core part of Rocket’s global ecosystem, Rocket India builds scalable technology platforms and digital solutions that simplify mortgage origination and servicing. Our teams work across Operations, Product, Technology, Innovation, and Customer functions to drive efficiency, enable smarter decisions, and support Rocket’s mission to “Help Everyone Home.” We are committed to providing a fair and inclusive workplace for all team members and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, religion, caste, disability, or gender identity, consistent with applicable Indian law, including the Constitution of India, the Code on Wages, 2019, the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, and the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and from all sections of society.”

title: Senior Enterprise Business Systems Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 Senior Enterprise Business Systems Engineer - Quote to Cash Hyderabad (Hybrid - 3 days onsite, 2 days remote) | Business Technology | Reports to: Director, Enterprise Business Systems 
 
 The Role 
 We re hiring a Senior Enterprise Business Systems Engineer to own the technical development and evolution of Nasuni s Quote-to-Cash systems. This role is centered on Salesforce CPQ and the integrations that connect quoting, pricing, approvals, and billing into a reliable end-to-end revenue process - from opportunity through order to cash collection in NetSuite. You ll be the developer who builds and maintains the CPQ configuration, writes the Apex and Flow automation that powers complex pricing and approval logic, designs the integration patterns between Salesforce and NetSuite, and ensures the entire quote-to-cash pipeline is scalable, accurate, and fast. You ll work closely with Revenue Operations, Finance, Deal Desk, and Sales to translate business rules into production-grade technical solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role - not administration and not ticket work. You ll own CI/CD pipelines, write code daily, manage deployments, and drive DevOps practices across the CPQ and quote-to-cash domain. If you want to engineer the revenue backbone of a high-growth SaaS company, this is the role. 
 
 What You ll Do 
 CPQ Development Configuration Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce CPQ solutions - product rules, pricing rules, discount schedules, quote templates, approval chains, and advanced quoting workflows. Build custom Apex triggers, classes, and batch processes that extend CPQ functionality beyond declarative configuration. Develop and optimize Salesforce Flows to automate quote lifecycle events, approval routing, and downstream data updates. Translate complex pricing models, bundling logic, and discount structures into scalable CPQ configurations that sales teams can use confidently. Troubleshoot and resolve CPQ calculation issues, performance bottlenecks, and edge cases in quote generation. Salesforce-to-NetSuite Integration Develop and maintain the integration between Salesforce and NetSuite that moves closed-won opportunities, order data, and billing information across systems accurately and reliably. Design integration patterns - field mappings, data transformations, error handling, retry logic, and reconciliation processes - that ensure data integrity between CRM and ERP. Workato is the preferred iPaaS: build and maintain recipes, connectors, and monitoring dashboards that support the Salesforce-NetSuite data flow. Partner with Finance and Accounting teams to ensure revenue recognition, invoicing, and order data are synchronized correctly. Diagnose and resolve integration failures, data mismatches, and sync errors across the quote-to-cash pipeline. Apex, Flow Platform Development Write clean, well-tested Apex code - triggers, classes, batch and scheduled jobs, REST/SOAP callouts - following Salesforce development best practices. Build and maintain complex Salesforce Flows for business process automation across the quote-to-cash lifecycle. Develop Lightning Web Components where custom UI is needed for quoting, approvals, or deal desk workflows. Enforce governor limit awareness, bulkification patterns, and separation of concerns in all platform code. DevOps, CI/CD Release Management Own and improve CI/CD pipelines for the CPQ and quote-to-cash domain using Git-based source control and deployment tools (Gearset or similar). Manage branching strategies, pull request reviews, environment promotion, and release planning across development, staging, and production orgs. Write and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and validation rules that protect deployment quality. Maintain deployment runbooks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification checklists. Delivery Collaboration Own technical delivery of quote-to-cash initiatives from requirements through production deployment. Write technical specifications, data flow diagrams, and solution design documents. Partner with Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Finance, and Sales to understand business requirements and translate them into well-engineered solutions. Troubleshoot production issues, drive root cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes. Mentor fellow developers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance. AI Intelligent Automation Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering while maintaining code quality and ownership. Identify opportunities for AI-enabled automation within the quote-to-cash process - intelligent approval routing, pricing recommendations, anomaly detection - with appropriate governance. Contribute to Nasuni s vision of an agentic GTM platform where AI agents connected through Model Context Protocols (MCPs) augment routine revenue operations. 
 
 Qualifications 
 
 Must Have 
 7+ years in enterprise application engineering, including 5+ years of Salesforce platform development. Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ - product configuration, pricing rules, discount schedules, approval processes, and quote templates. Deep Apex development skills - triggers, classes, batch/scheduled jobs, callouts, test classes - with a focus on clean, maintainable code. Strong Salesforce Flow development skills for business process automation. Hands-on experience managing integrations between Salesforce and NetSuite (or comparable ERP), including field mapping, data transformation, and error handling. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based development workflows (Gearset, Copado, or similar). Solid understanding of REST APIs, event-driven integrations, webhooks, and data synchronization patterns. Experience working with DevOps practices in a Salesforce environment - source control, branching strategies, automated testing, environment management. Salesforce Platform Developer I certification. Salesforce Administrator certification. Bachelor s in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. 
 
 Preferred 
 Experience with Workato as an integration platform - recipes, connectors, callable recipes, error handling, and API management. Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification. Platform Developer II certification. Experience with Salesforce Billing or Revenue Cloud. Familiarity with NetSuite SuiteScript, saved searches, or SuiteTalk APIs. SQL proficiency for data analysis, troubleshooting, and reporting validation. Experience with LWC development for custom quoting or deal desk interfaces. Track record of mentoring developers and guiding technical initiatives at high-growth SaaS companies. 
 
 Ideal 
 B2B Solution Architect or OmniStudio Developer credentials. Experience with headless, API-first, or composable CRM modernization in the quote-to-cash domain. Experience designing multi-currency, multi-entity, or channel/partner quoting models. AI-enabled workflow automation - agentic patterns, intelligent approval flows, or AI-assisted pricing optimization. Genesys Cloud Testing Engineer Role Overview We are looking for a skilled Genesys Cloud Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of Genesys Cloud CX contact center solutions. The role will be responsible for planning, designing, executing, and reporting testing activities across voice, IVR, routing, digital channels, integrations, reporting, and contact center operational workflows. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and execute test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts for Genesys Cloud CX solutions. Perform functional, integration, regression, system integration testing, user acceptance testing support, and production validation. Validate Genesys Cloud components including Architect flows, IVR, queues, skills-based routing, inbound and outbound call flows, callback, campaigns, digital channels, and reporting dashboards. Test integrations with CRM platforms, telephony systems, SIP/SBC, WebRTC, APIs, workforce management, call recording, and third-party applications. Analyze business requirements, technical specifications, and call-flow designs to ensure complete test coverage. Identify, document, track, and manage defects using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar platforms. Collaborate with developers, platform teams, business users, operations, and project stakeholders to resolve issues and ensure timely defect closure. Support migration, cutover, release validation, and hypercare activities for Genesys Cloud implementations and enhancements. Prepare testing status reports, quality metrics, defect summaries, and release readiness updates for project stakeholders. Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, automation practices, reusable test assets, and quality assurance standards. Required Skills Hands-on experience in Genesys Cloud CX or Genesys contact center testing. Strong understanding of contact center concepts including IVR, ACD, call routing, queues, skills, agent desktop, call recording, and reporting. Experience in testing voice, digital, chat, email, outbound dialing, and CRM-integrated contact center solutions. Knowledge of telephony concepts such as SIP, SBC, BYOC, WebRTC, DTMF, and call recording validation. Ability to create detailed test cases from requirements, process flows, call-flow diagrams, and solution designs. Experience with defect management, test execution tracking, and requirements traceability. Good understanding of Agile delivery methodology and software testing life cycle processes. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Engineering, or a related field. 3-6 years of experience in software testing, system testing, or contact center testing. Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud CX, Genesys Engage, or similar contact center platforms is preferred. Experience working with enterprise contact center transformation, migration, or enhancement projects. ISTQB Foundation certification or equivalent QA/testing certification is an added advantage. Preferred Skills Experience with Salesforce and Genesys integration testing. Exposure to automation testing tools and test automation frameworks. Knowledge of reporting validation, dashboards, historical data, CDR, billing, and quality management features. Experience supporting SIT, UAT, production deployment, and post-go-live validation. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, client-facing delivery environment.

Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems Shipping the feature Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding Work out why a launch is or isnt working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties What Were Looking For 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: youve built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed B2B SaaS experience is a must Startup experience is required. title: Project Planning & Controls Lead
description:
Job Summary The Project Planning Controls Lead is responsible for providing planning leadership, schedule governance, and delivery assurance for data center construction and infrastructure projects delivered under a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) model. Acting as the client s planning and controls representative, the role ensures that integrated master schedules, progress reporting, and forecasting frameworks are robust, accurate, and aligned with delivery objectives. The position works closely with Project Managers, Project Directors, contractors, consultants, and client stakeholders to provide clear, data-driven insights that support timely decision-making and delivery certainty across one or multiple mission-critical data center projects. Key Responsibilities Planning Controls Leadership Lead planning and controls activities across the full project lifecycle, including design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover. Develop, maintain, and govern integrated master schedules and detailed project programs in alignment with PMC and client standards. Establish planning principles, schedule structures, coding, and reporting frameworks across the project portfolio. Act as the central authority for schedule integrity, logic, and baseline management. Schedule Development Governance Review, validate, and integrate contractor and consultant schedules into a coordinated master program. Ensure alignment of design, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities across all workstreams. Define and manage key milestones, critical paths, and interface dependencies. Support phasing strategies, fast-track delivery, and concurrent construction models common to data center projects. Progress Monitoring, Analysis Reporting Implement consistent progress measurement methodologies across all disciplines and contractors. Track progress against baselines, identify variances, and provide forward-looking forecasts. Prepare high-quality schedule reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for client and project leadership. Highlight risks to milestones and critical paths, with clear mitigation and recovery options. Risk, Change Recovery Planning Support identification of schedule-related risks and development of mitigation strategies. Perform schedule impact assessments for changes, delays, and scope adjustments. Support recovery planning, acceleration strategies, and what-if scenario analysis. Contribute to risk registers and delivery assurance reviews from a planning perspective. Delay Analysis, Claims Review Forensic Support Perform schedule delay analysis using appropriate methodologies (e.g., impacted as-planned, time impact analysis, as-built vs. as-planned). Review contractor delay notifications, extension of time (EOT) submissions, and time-related claims from a planning and technical perspective. Independently assess the validity of delay causes, critical path impacts, and entitlement implications (schedule-focused, non-commercial). Support the client and Project Director with objective, data-driven advice related to delay responsibility and mitigation options. Maintain robust schedule records and contemporaneous updates to support defensible delay assessments. Contractor Consultant Coordination Coordinate closely with contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and multidisciplinary consultants. Challenge and validate contractor progress updates, logic, sequencing, and forecasts. Facilitate planning workshops, look-ahead sessions, and interface coordination meetings. Promote consistent planning standards and a collaborative, transparent approach to schedule management. Technical Expertise (Data Center Focus) Experience working in mission-critical and data center delivery environments. Strong understanding of data center construction sequencing and phased handover strategies. Knowledge of commissioning, integrated systems testing (IST), and readiness-for-operations sequencing. Familiarity with redundancy-driven sequencing, concurrent builds, and live environment constraints. Ability to interpret technical inputs from electrical, mechanical, ICT, and specialist systems into integrated schedules. Tools Methodologies Advanced proficiency in planning and controls tools such as Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project. Experience with reporting and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI or equivalent). Working knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, or equivalent project controls methodologies. Understanding of schedule risk analysis, critical path management, and planning best practices. Strong data management and reporting governance capability. Qualifications Experience Education Bachelor s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline. Experience 15-20 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, or project controls. Direct experience supporting data center or mission-critical infrastructure projects. Proven experience managing integrated schedules across complex, multi-contractor environments. Professional Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory) PMP, PMI-SP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management or planning certification. Primavera P6 professional certification is an advantage. Core Competencies Strong coordination and contractor interface management skills. Excellent analytical and problem-solving capability.
